Bondi's chiselled lifeguards get a run for their money when all-male-revue Manpower Australia make a surprise visit. A colourful Bondi local is found facedown and unresponsive in the sand. Singlets races to a rescue in the buggy but faces obstacles with flocks of seagulls.

500 Dutch tourists storm into the surf to celebrate New Year's Day. On the promenade Singlets treats a rollerblader with a severely dislocated knee. And American Superstar Comedian, Conan O'Brien, tries his hand at lifeguarding - with hilarious results.

Reidy is haunted by the memory of a man drowning in the south corner as he rescues two swimmers in the same spot. A woman suffering from heatstroke loses her 3-year-old son. Bluebottles invade Bondi, and Jesse and Hoppo engage in a mass rescue where people are pushing each other under.

Big swell and powerful rips at Bondi's south corner. Lifeguard Yatesy attempts the rescue of an inexperienced surfer in 10-foot swell. Meanwhile, increased shark sightings prompt the lifeguards to test new deterrent technology for the future safety of Bondi swimmers and lifeguards.

An 18 year old man breaks his leg and lifeguards administer analgesic pain killer. Maxi uses a tracking device to locate a thief. Corey struggles to stay calm when a bunch of Chinese school kids run wild. Local resident and amateur singer, Cora pens a tune about Bondi's hard working lifeguards.

A simple miscommunication during a serious rescue could cost two people their lives. Mouse and Chappo help a family to find their lost Grandma. Jess administers adrenaline to a young woman who is suffering an allergic reaction.

In the most powerful episode ever, two people from the same family drown. The remaining family members watch as lifeguards attempt to resuscitate them, marking a crisis not faced by lifeguards since 1939.

Tragedy unfolds as a Chinese backpacker is left comatose after-hours. A father loses his son in a massive crowd. Lifeguards struggle communicating with the distressed Cambodian man. Former ironman Kailan Collins shares the details of his rare injury for the first time in seventeen years.

A lifeless swimmer is dragged from the water between the flags. A surprisingly muscle-bound metal-detecting expert is called in when a backpacker buries her belongings. And the lifeguards bid farewell to another successful season with a fancy dress surfing competition.

Cyclonic swell hits Bondi Beach with 12-foot waves, posing a significant challenge for Harries during a board rescue off Ben Buckler. In addition to the man in danger, H intervenes to lecture drunken youths burying beer bottles in the sand. New drone life vest technology is tested at Bondi Beach.

A surfer seeks refuge at the tower from an angry beachgoer, requiring lifeguards to maintain public safety until police arrive. Colorful characters visit the beach, including Spiderman and Green Goblin. The annual lifeguard race has the participating teams getting highly competitive.

Chappo and H-man cautiously prepare a 19 year old German tourist for hospital after he's broken his back. Trainees Taco and Jesse have a difficult day in class struggling with the books, but get a chance to make the grade against the rest of the team in the annual lifeguard challenge.

Lifeguards respond to a woman with a suspected heart attack on Campbell Parade. Jethro treats a female backpacker experiencing anaphylaxis with an EpiPen. Jesse and Jethro compete: surfer vs. bodyboarder. A severe dislocated shoulder necessitates the use of two green whistles.

2016 dawns on Bondi with drug and alcohol-affected masses taking lifeguards to another level. A 300-person-strong Dutch contingent raises the stakes even further. Nicola loses her cool with beachgoers, and Singlets and Mario lose their cool with each other.

Lifeguards face frustrating distractions involving lost gear, wayward children, ball games, and somersaults. A mother searches for her 6-year-old son last seen in the surf. The arrival of blue bottles overwhelms the lifeguard tower, and a small boy must alert them to a drowning girl.

Claiming she has no lingering attachment, Jeongi leaves the Bunwon behind, and Gwanghae watches her go in hollow disbelief. After returning to her former home, Jeongi and Taedo are suddenly seized by military officers, who drag Taedo away. Gwanghae pleads with Inbin to release him, insisting that Taedo once served as his personal guard. Awakened by her mother Yeonok's voice, Jeongi rises and walks toward the kiln…

King Seonjo orders Gwanghae, Imhae, and Shinseong to find a way to end the people's widespread stomach illness, prompting Gwanghae to disguise himself and investigate in secret. While surveying the village, he unexpectedly encounters Jeongi, who is making and distributing bowls to the villagers. Jeongi carefully presents a vessel she crafted especially for Gwanghae. Soon, a royal decree is issued for the Bunwon to produce pottery for the common people, and Gwanghae sets out to find Jeongi.

Despite Taedo's warnings that it is dangerous, Jeongi insists she must remain at the Bunwon to bring Gangcheon down from his nangcheong post. Reunited with Jeongi at the workshop, Gwanghae cannot hide his quiet delight. Meanwhile, Yukdo grows uneasy when he is forced to compete with Jeongi to create the lid for King Seonjo's cherished jar. He promises Jeongi that if she succeeds, he will elevate her to the rank of master potter.

When King Seonjo selects Yukdo's lid, Yukdo struggles to contain his joy, while Jeongi graciously acknowledges his skill. Gwanghae petitions the king to lift the Chief Scholar's exile, but Seonjo misinterprets the request as a threat to royal authority. Seizing the moment, Inbin plots to frame Gwanghae for treason by forging his letter. As Jeongi departs on Gangcheon's errand to mine white clay, Gwanghae mounts his horse and races after her.

Upon returning to the palace, Gwanghae insists that the letter King Seonjo presents to him has been forged—but the king refuses to believe it. Jeongi is shaken when Imhae warns her that anyone tied to the alleged treason will not escape unscathed. When Jeongi meets Gwanghae, she vows to restrain even her own feelings so as not to become a burden to him. Court Lady Gukbi is stunned to learn that Jeongi is Yeonok's daughter.

After uncovering the full truth, Jeongi begins searching for a way to bring about Gangcheon's downfall, with Taedo pledging to help her. When Jeongi and Gwanghae cross paths at the Bunwon, they share a tender, wordless gaze filled with longing. Upon discovering a ledger detailing Gangcheon's bribes, Jeongi resolves to win Royal Consort Inbin's favor. Meanwhile, Hwa-ryeong decides to eliminate Son Haengsu.

While on a mission to the big city to replace Nicole's malfunctioning microchip, Sonic and Sally encounter the Guardian, a mysterious cloaked figure who guards a dormant wizard named Lazar and his computer of evil spells.
Sonic is hired into an obvious trap when a frustrated Robotnik decides to appeal to the Hedgehog's ego and announces a "race to determine the fastest on Mobius".

Sonic conquers Robotnik's latest evil - a vehicle designated to locate and destroy living tissue matter - during a solo mission to the Badlands. Upon Sonic's return, the Freedom Fighters honor him with a victory party.

When Robotnik launches a spy-orb that will uncover the Freedom Fighter's Knothole location, Sonic and Robot launch themselves up to the orbiting spy-sphere aboard a home-made rocket powered by Robotnik's discarded booster engine.

When Sally uncovers Robotnik's plan to seed the cloud with toxic rain, they attempt a daring mission to sabotage the dirigible-like craft being transported by land vehicles. Mission fails when Sally, Bunnie and Antoine are captured.

When Sonic and The Freedom Fighters take out Robotnik's main computer, they're trapped by Swat-Bots in an underground tunnel, only to be rescued by a handsome teenager named Griff. Griff takes them deep beneath the Big City.
Robotnik severely upsets the ecosystem above and below the surface, when he sends explosive, Robotnik snake probes drilling deep under ground in search of oil lakes.

Tails brings a new friend home to Knothole - a baby Terra-Pod who has strayed from the herd that is currently migrating. Sonic, Sally, and some of the other Freedom Fighters return the Baby-T to its mom and the rest of the herd.

Sonic reluctantly takes Tails with him to the Big City to find some cotter pins for the Freedom Fighters catapults. While in the City, Sonic is nearly eaten alive by his old dog Muttski, now a roboti-sized guard dog in the Junk Heaps
The Hedgehogs congregate on the Floating Island in their latest effort to find their mother. But Sleet and Dingo also have an interest in this island.
As Sonic begins to chow chili dogs for a snack, he finds a message in the sack from his mother urging him to head to Speedster Island.
Sonic becomes aggravated that maybe their efforts of fighting for freedom seem pointless. Sonia suggests that they go to the Oracle for advice.
Robotnik has his eyes set upon Queen Aleena's crown jewel, but Sonic, Manic and Sonia plan to retrieve the gem before Robotnik.

Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

Forensic psychologists delve into the minds of serial killers, explaining why, most often, they can be a friendly neighbor or the tenacious co-worker  the one who hides his or her dark side better than anyone else.

There's never a good reason for murder, but some killers are particularly brutalchoosing their prey at random or with no apparent motive and then cunningly covering their tracks. Even so, telltale clues remain.

Explosives Investigations: The crime lab is the place where science meets murder. In New York State, Eleanor Fowler opened a small package, which as mailed to her home. When she lifted the lid the box exploded killing her instantly.
The tread of a tire, a single shoe print and even the shape of a bruise help investigators track down killers, based solely on their patterns of guilt.
What does it take to prove murder if the victim cannot be found? Investigators must go to extreme lengths to catch the killer when the victim is presumed dead.

It is difficult to convict a murderer if the body can't be found. But forensic science is finding ways to do it. Devious killers can think up many was to dispose of their victim's remains, but they are often no matches for investigators.

Suzanne gets arrested and decides to change her stubborn ways.
Kevin tries to run for seventh-grade class president, but he is torn about how to run his campaign.
The family tries become environmental friendly with each other but chaos ensures

Lindsey gets her first job at a fast food restaurant, but soon gets fired when she gives out free food.
Nick tries to become a more effective parent, so he pushes Kevin and Lindsey to become better people.
Against Nick's wishes, Suzanne buys an expensive purse and Nick becomes suspicious about it, so he uses her guilt to his advantage.
Suzanne becomes the subject to Nick's joke-off, and Suzanne retaliates against him.
When Nick makes a point that Suzanne is too controlling of the family, Suzanne backs off the issue and later the family realizes that her controlling ways are just what they need.
Nick, Suzanne, and Kevin pull pranks on each other, but their addiction leads to a near-death experience.
Gigi uses an adequate exercise when the family refuses to stop fighting with each other.
Suzanne's overprotective mother arrives and causes tension between her and Nick when she questions Nick's abilities as a husband.
A newly hired, attractive woman threatens Nick's job at the station.
When Marilyn brings a dangerous flu back from a trip to Mexico, the family must stay inside their house under quarantine.
Nick angers Suzanne when he invites Martin to an exclusive sporting event before inviting his wife.
Lindsey auditions to dance for a famous rapper's music video, but she later backs out after meeting with the powerful, demanding choreographer.
For Career Day, Nick serves as a guest speaker for Kevin's class, but his message ultimately confuses Kevin's classmates.
Nick and Suzanne's next door's neighbors become irresponsible house sitters.
Nick struggles to prove himself when he is promoted to co-host alongside the lazy, arrogant Brick Street.
Suzanne tries to keep Nick's birthday gift a surprise by taking out a loan from Marilyn.
Suzanne gathers everyone up for a family portrait.

programmes.st: The Nick Hosts a Telethon Episode
programmes.d: Nick host a fund-raiser for charity. Elsewhere, Suzanne tangles with a wealthy client.
Sam's poorly misguided plan to win Drew's affection rebounds.
Hattie, Troy, and Drew try to babysit Baby Celina.
In the series finale, Sam and Drew explain their feelings for each other.

programmes.st: What's Love Got to Do With It
programmes.d: Hattie Mae wants her grandson, Danny, to get a job and move out of her house. Meanwhile, her daughter, Linda, moves back home after her husband cheated on her.
Linda, broke and betrayed, considers reconciling with her unfaithful husband against Hattie’s wishes, while Danny saves enough money to leave home.
Sam learns that Linda has received a key from Danny to the bachelor pad, and he demands that he get it back from her after she walks in on him while he is nude.
Linda copes with her son after her divorce is finalized while Sam has a problem with Danny's mother visiting too often.
Hattie uses love as a tactic to have Linda defend herself. Meanwhile, Linda asks to stay at Floyd's apartment after Hattie kicks her out.
At the diner, the health inspector comes in for an unannounced visit and Linda starts her first day working. Floyd and Linda frantically work to bring the diner up to code.

Ryan steps up his boss game. Kat betrays 9 Mag in order to take her Kat Tat brand to the next level. Don's old college fling claims that he's the father of her child, threatening his engagement to Ashley. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Prison on the Outside, Party on the Inside
programmes.d: Kat learns that Charmaine threw her personal items in the trash. Don takes a paternity test hoping to squash the rumors that he fathered a love child.  Van is released from boot camp but rising tensions put a damper on his homecoming. Presented by VH1.

Don's paternity test results send him on a downward spiral. Van has an emotional reunion with his daughter after being separated from her. Danielle's birthday celebration turns into chaos when Ashley and her friends attack Charmaine. Presented by VH1.

Charmaine faces the consequences of quitting her corporate job and following her dreams. Ashley confronts Don about fathering a child with another woman. Tempers flare when Ryan introduces yet another new tattoo artist in the shop. Presented by VH1.

The crew heads to New Orleans for some Bourbon Street debauchery. Charmaine's family demands that she moves back home when they find out she's broke. Don is caught off guard when his baby mama Whitney ambushes him at 9 Mag. Presented by VH1.

Don brings his two baby mamas together in hopes of uniting his family. Ryan celebrates his 30th birthday with a Great Gatsby themed bash. And Danielle's boyfriend Terrence makes a fool of himself when his jealousy gets the best of him. Presented by VH1.

O'S**t's past has come back to haunt him when a mystery woman turns up at the shop. While Dutch reconnects with everyone but Ceaser. During the party, Cease and Puma have an idea that has the potential to change Black Ink's future. Presented by VH1.

With Dutchess doing her own thing, Ceaser focuses on the shop and all of the drama that comes with it. An already crazy mixxxy party gets interesting when O'S**t and new shop apprentice Donna are caught in the bathroom together. Presented by VH1.
O'S**t's attorney, Paul Lieber, pulls some strings in the courtroom in attempt to get O'S**t out of his legal mess. Dutchess invites Quani on her upcoming trip to Paris. Presented by VH1.
Ceaser and the crew are flying high on the new renovations, but when it's time to say "Bon voyage" to Dutchess, Ceaser begins having second thoughts about his former flame. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew C'est La Vie
programmes.d: Ceaser takes Sky's advice to heart and decides to take a little trip across the globe to surprise Dutchess. While Ceaser and Dutchess spend time together in Paris, Quani tries to come to terms with her feelings about her husband, Puma. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Ain't No Thing But a Chicken Wing
programmes.d: Ceaser and Dutchess have returned from Paris as a couple and the crew wonders what this means for the future of the shop. Quani tells Puma that she wants a career and is pissed when Puma laughs it off. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew No Leg to Stand On
programmes.d: Ceaser and Dutchess finally show up at the shop and Donna and Ceaser go at it. Walt reunites with his long lost family and O'S**t, still in rehab, receives frightening news. Presented by VH1.

With Anya in the hospital, O'S**t tries to fix his relationship. Sassy decides to introduce her new girlfriend to the crew. Meanwhile, Ceaser, Dutchess, & Ted go to Arizona to bring Sky home but find out Sky's facing 8 years in jail. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Sky is the New Black
programmes.d: Ted's true feelings come to light upon Sky's 2-month sentence to Tent City, one of the most controversial jails in the world. Puma's business partner, Med, plays mediator trying to squash the beef and bring the old friends back together. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Now It's Turned All The Way Up
programmes.d: Quani and Puma are officially "turned up", causing them to miss the Black Ink photo shoot. O'S**t heads to court to find out the outcome of his gun charge. Quani curses out Ceaser, causing a full-blown riot on the streets of Harlem. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew This is Not a Talk Show
programmes.d: The pressure is on for Ceaser when Dutchess' parents arrive for their engagement party. Quani and Puma make it clear that this war isn't over. Sky struggles with the emotions she feels over leaving Tent City. Presented by VH1.

As Danny and Baez investigate the murders of three prominent community leaders who appear to be the casualties of hate crimes, Frank meets with a group that wants to make sure these incidents are not taken lightly.
Danny is conflicted when he learns that a group of highly trained Army veterans are responsible for a robbery.

Frank pushes to find evidence against a suspected cop killer who shot one of Henry's fellow officers years ago. Meanwhile, Danny and Baez investigate a string of murders involving adult film stars, on BLUE BLOODS.

Jamie gets Danny involved when he finds a homeless teen who claims his aunt was killed by her boyfriend. Meanwhile, Erin is angered when McCoy replaces her as the prosecutor on a case involving a corrections officer.

Danny and Baez investigate when a homeowner shoots an intruder, only to find out that the intruder is a hitman. Also, a young attorney attempts to bring justice to his mother who Erin put away on a murder charge 12 years ago.
Danny and Baez investigate a murder of a lower-income resident in a luxury building where 20 percent of the units are made affordable for lower-income housing.
When a star witness in a double murder case drops out, Erin is tasked with bringing a protected mob informant back to New York for a case and keeping him safe, with help from Danny and Baez.
When an emotionally distraught man holds Baez hostage at gunpoint in an interrogation room after she served him with a restraining order, Danny must try to meet his demands before he harms her.

Erin is rattled when an unknown assailant breaks into her apartment and also attacks her co-worker. Meanwhile, Jamie and Eddie discover a pipe bomb in an elderly woman's apartment, and Frank looks into a charity that is soliciting money for the NYPD.

Eddie goes on her first undercover operation to investigate a kidnapping ring targeting young women via fake youth hostel websites. Meanwhile, Frank helps a woman he knows from early in his career meet the inmate who killed her family.
Frank goes toe to toe with an investigative journalist who refuses to give up her source, despite the source admitting to committing murder.
When a suspect voluntarily admits to killing a reality show celebrity chef in his own restaurant, Danny and Baez are convinced the suspect is taking the fall for someone.

When an assassination of someone close to Frank transpires, Frank orders all hands on deck to catch the killer. Working the case, Danny and Baez go see Mario Hunt ('Method Man'), a well-known member of a deadly gang.
When a member of the Reagan clan is shot, Danny tries to track down the gang member responsible, without letting his emotions get the best of him.
Frank goes on high alert when a threat to New York City may be imminent following a terrorist attack in the Middle East, on the sixth season premiere of BLUE BLOODS.
Danny and Baez investigate a possible serial killer who sends a chilling message to Danny, and Erin toys with the idea of applying for a judgeship.

programmes.st: All the News That’s Fit To Click
programmes.d: When newspaper reporter Lorenzo Colt (Zachary Booth) is targeted while wearing NYPD gear on a ride-along with Jamie and Eddie, Frank puts Danny and Baez on the hunt for the shooter who may be out for other members on the force.
The Cartwrights attempt to straighten out the snobbish young son of Ben's cousin.
The Generation Gap, Western-style, as Hoss tries to bring a young man and his father closer together.
Hoss is engaged to Carol Attley, a troubled woman with a past darker than he imagines.
Hoss wants to marry mysterious Regan Miller, a woman with less than a pristine past.  When he thinks Adam is trying to steal her away, he loses control and beats Adam up.
A Mormon with two wives is badgered by the town's people and then things get much worse.
As the persecuted party awaits Ben and Hoss' return, Herber is shot and killed. Joe retaliates and shoots Herber's assassin.
Hoss helps Charlie and Will (Charlotte and Willomina), two young girls who just lost their father.  They go on a journey to find their only nearby relative, Aunt Cloe.
Hoss volunteers to pickup an injured neighbor's mail-order bride, but by the time they return, she has fallen in love with Hoss and a price is put on Hoss' head.
Hoss relies on clever attorney Whitney Parker, who has a drinking problem, to clear him of a murder charge.
Ben's attempt to rehabilitate an alcoholic singer he knew in better days are complicated by her involvment with a former prize fighter.

Two robberies take place on stagecoaches that Adam is traveling on, and both times a knight in shining armor scares the robbers away.  Adam is accused of robbery, and his story about the knight is none too helpful.
Adam, Hoss and Joe mistakenly believe their father was murdered.  They split into 3 different directions to confront the supposed killers.
Ben helps Matthew Raine, a famous painter who has gone blind and now wallows in self-pity, discover a new purpose in life.  However, Raine's employee Gavin has other ideas.

Clay Stafford signs on to work for the Cartwrights and shortly afterwards shoots and kills a man who accuses him of cheating at poker.  The miners warn Clay to leave town, but it appears he killed in self-defense.
When Hoss is responsible for causing a hung jury, Ben tells him, "a man is never wrong doing what he thinks is right", and Adam attempts to validate his brother's reasonable doubt.
Mary Wharton, an old friend of the family, comes to live on the Ponderosa with her shiftless husband.  When Ben learns Mary is the victim of domestic abuse, he sends Russ packing.
While talking with an Indian, Ben is given an unexpected present... a woman.  She is a young white woman named Joan who has lived with the Indians since she was a little girl.

Grissom, Catherine, and Nick investigate the death of a runner during a competition. Meanwhile, Sara and Warrick investigate the death of a couple in a hotel room, initially thought to be a murder-suicide.
A roller coaster runs off its track, leaving six people dead. The CSI team investigates whether this was an accident or foul play.
Two young men are found murdered after scamming Sam Braun's casinos.
A casino employee is beaten and raped on her way home from work, but she survives and identifies her attacker.
While Grissom leads a group of college students on a tour of CSI, the dead speak while the CSIs investigate, each narrating their own case
The CSIs investigate first-hand the behind-the-scenes action of Cirque du Soleil in order to determine what may have contributed to a young dancer's untimely death.
Grissom is fascinated when every detail of a miniature is identical to that of a real crime scene, and he goes about trying to solve the case using the clues provided.

When an innocent man is brutally attacked and beaten to death by what looks like a monster in a black cape, the CSIs are called to investigate, only to learn that a similar attack took place minutes later.
When a dead woman is found hanging from a cross inside a church, the team follows the evidence to uncover a bizarre love triangle dating all the way back to the victim's high school days.
When two young boys are reported missing, a known neighborhood sex offender is the primary suspect.
While investigating an elderly woman's murder, Grissom receives a miniature crime scene replica; Greg attends a hearing to ascertain his culpability in a teenager's accidental death.

When identical twins are found dead, the evidence in both cases does not immediately prove a connection between the two deaths. However, as the CSIs dig deeper into the histories of the women, a surprising twist takes the investigation in a new direction.
Grissom and his team investigate a string of murders in Las Vegas that may be tied to an infamous mob boss from the 1970s who disappeared many years ago.
When the CSIs process clues after a murder at a poultry manufacturing plant, the evidence leads them to the home of a man who collects miniature trains and other miniature paraphernalia.

Catherine's testimony in court is not enough to convict a killer suspected of murdering his own mother. Adam Novak, with whom Catherine had a brief romantic encounter, is the lawyer who represents the killer and secures his freedom.
The lead suspect for the high-profile murder of anti-drug crusading assemblyman Danilo Zamesca is Thomas Simon, the west coast's biggest drug supplier.

As Catherine and Keppler begin to investigate the murder of a teen-aged Jane Doe, both agree that the killer, who was meticulous in removing evidence from the body and its surrounding area, is likely a repeat offender.
After a plastic surgery anesthesiologist is found dead from an apparent suicide, Horatio thinks that this could be a case of murder.
A diamond broker is shot to death in a parking garage, a mentally disabled man witnessed the murder and wants to help Horatio solve the crime.
When a man, Juan Marco Varon, who may or may not have tortured Cuban refuges is murdered, the CSIs are called in to investigate.
Horatio and his team delve into the world of celebrity and investigate the murder of a paparazzi. He discovers the victim witnessed another murder.
Ted Henderson is killed in his own home and his body is missing, while his wife and son are left alive, but beaten and bound.
In the Everglades, near a controlled burn, Alexx and Delko search the crime scene. They are forced to take cover when a wall of fire overtakes them.
Horatio is quick to arrive on the scene when an armored truck carrying 3.2 million dollars is robbed in a daring downtown heist.
Wally Shmagin literally becomes part of a murder crime scene after he steals a latex glove to add to his personal forensic collection.
A slippery journalist is the only witness to a murder, and Horatio suspects that he may be looking for a much bigger story.
When a police officer is shot to death while on the job, the CSIs track who he saw while that night and learn that he picked-up a call girl.
CSIs investigate the lives of those living in a high-end airpark after a prop plane crashes into a local Miami beach hot spot.
A security guard is found dead after shots ring out at rap star 10-Large’s concert and the CSI are called in to investigate.
When evidence at a murder investigation leads the CSIs to believe the killer may be in NYC, Horatio takes his investigation to the Big Apple.
An adult film actress is found strangled to death in the park and the CSIs are called in to investigate and find the killer.
As Delko's life hangs in the balance, Horatio flashes back 12 years to reveal how Miami's CSIs first met and became a team.
When the lab is attacked, Horatio must fulfill a gunman's unique request in order to save five hostages, including new CSI Jesse Cardoza.
Three volleyball players mysteriously drop dead on the court, while Calleigh's testimony against Delko threatens his future as a CSI.
After being injured, Mac watches his neighbors while recuperating and witnesses mysterious activity that leads to murder.
The CSI New York team of investigators follows a trail left by Shane Casey and realizes he is targeting a vacationing Danny out of revenge.
The newest CSI New York team of investigators’ team members is welcomed by stumbling upon a woman murdered in the NYPD crime lab building.
When a young woman appears to be strangled while in a live online chat that Adam witnesses the CSIs must determine if it was real or a hoax.
When a couple is found beaten in their home, the CSIs think they have the suspect after a mother ID's her son, but all is not what it seems.
When a powerful gang leader is murdered, the CSI New York team of investigators must find the killer before a street war breaks out.
A jewel heist at the penthouse of one of New York's most powerful attorneys takes a bizarre turn as the case leads the CSIs to a man in the morgue.
The CSI New York team of investigators finds a body on a rooftop and must find the killer who is manipulating crime scenes.
With a sniper lose in New York City, Mac must relive an abduction case that might have created one of the city's deadliest foes.
The CSI New York team of investigators experience eerie occurrences after a woman is found who has literally been scared to death.
Mac goes up against the deputy chief of detectives when a dark secret from the chief's past threatens his reputation and family.
Mac and the CSI New York team search for the killer of a department store manager found dead in a holiday display window.
When a man in full clown costume shoots a bakery owner, the CSIs investigate and discover a decision from Flack's past that may put him in jeopardy.
When a Spanish club promoter is found dead, Detective Mac Taylor must battle with the head of Barcelona's crime lab to solve the case.
When a tractor-trailer carrying party guests mysteriously ends up at the bottom of the Hudson River, the CSIs must exhume the soggy remains.
When the CSIs track down a suave and charming hitman, their investigation uncovers a conspiracy with far-reaching implications.
When a serial rapist is murdered, restrained in the same manner as his victims, the CSIs weigh a feeling of justice against their sense of duty.

Under the pressure that the Halliwell sisters will discover his evil plot, Gideon conspires with two demons to make Piper, Phoebe and Paige part of 'Witch Wars', a new demonic reality television show.

programmes.st: It's A Bad, Bad, Bad, Bad World, Part 1 & 2
programmes.d: Gideon creates a portal that puts Chris and Leo in a mirrored world where evil prevails, and Phoebe and Paige travel to the parallel universe to rescue them. Meanwhile, Piper gives birth to baby Chris.

A grief-stricken Piper and Leo attend a Hindu wedding, where they inadvertently receive the powers of Hindu gods, and it's up to Phoebe and Paige to keep them from consummating their love in order to save the universe.

The Charmed Ones have their hands full, when thanks to a bored Magic School student, they must keep Lord Dyson from killing the infamous Lady Godiva before she can travel back in time and complete her famous ride.
When Paige and Phoebe summon Grams for Chris' Wiccaning, Grams puts a spell on the children to try to end their sibling rivalry, but instead it reverts the sisters back to bickering teenagers.

When Paige encounters Captain Black Jack Cutting, an 18th century pirate in search of the Fountain of Youth, the curse on his life becomes her problem. Meanwhile, Leslie manipulates a contest in order to spend time with Phoebe.

In an attempt to stop a demon on a murderous rampage upon his human relatives, Paige casts a spell that inadvertently blocks all death, and it's up to the Charmed Ones to make things right, when the Angel of Death wants the mess cleaned up.

A blue moon causes problems right after the Elders', suspicious of Leo, assign the sisters a new whitelighter. Meanwhile, Agent Brody tells Paige of a powerful new threat, and Phoebe and Leslie confess their true feelings for each other.
Agent Brody and Paige investigate when they discover that the demon Sarpedon is capturing innocents' guardian angels and using them to protect himself from the new power.
Paige and Agent Brody, are drawn into an unfinished novel that takes place in the 1930s, and they must elude the gangsters in pursuit of the famed Burmese Falcon.

Piper learns Leo is an Avatar, when he confesses to her, despite the objections of the other Avatars, who believe Piper should find out on her own. Meanwhile, Phoebe and Paige ask Kyle for help, but his reaction proves disastrous.

The Avatars enlist Leo to protect the Seer because she has information that could help them destroy the demons. Meanwhile, Brody reveals a secret to Paige, and Phoebe and Darryl continue to investigate Brody.
When Piper switches powers with Phoebe, to allow her to see the vision of the utopian world, Zankou interferes, and causes their powers to be transferred to innocent bystanders, who run amok.
At the same time that the Avatars are planning to transform the world into their envisioned utopia, Zankou kidnaps Brody and is forced to cast a paranoia spell on the Halliwell sisters.
Leo discovers that the Charmed Ones' conflict-free world comes with a higher price than anticipated, so he must join Zankou to stop the Avatars and reverse the change.
When Paige tries to hire a new professor for the Magic School, one of the candidates, Drake, turns out to be an ex-demon who made a deal with a sorcerer to become human.
Frasier conducts an experiment in voter psychology by getting Woody on the ballot for city council.
Carla takes over as bartender when Woody takes his position as city councilman.
Rebecca uses her classical music knowledge to woo Kelly's wealthy father.
Rebecca makes a fool out of herself at Mr. Gaines' exclusive party.
Despite Rebecca's rich taste in men, she falls for a local plumber.
Sam gets an unexpected visit from his ex-flame and Cheers favorite, Diane.
Reconciliation comes for Sam and Diane after an unexpected turn of events.
Sam and Diane are plagued with doubts about getting back together.
Diane Chambers makes her home at Cheers when her fiancé leaves her.
Diane can't conceal her scorn for Sam's parade of beautiful, yet shallow dates, and puts him on the defensive about his taste in women.
Diane suggests Carla consult a psychologist to learn to control her temper.
Sam's sportscaster friend wants to feature him on his television show.
Coach discourages his daughter from marrying her pompous and rude fiancé.
After a ruined romance with an intellectual, Diane's prim friend Rebecca confides she's looking for a fling with someone earthy. To Diane's dismay, she sets her sights on Sam.
Norm asks Diane to fill in as his bosses' date for the firm's annual bash.
Sam steps in as a mediator between the bickering Carla and Diane.
Coach feels he can't compete with Sam when they fall for the same woman.
Sam loans out his lucky cap to a baseball player who's in a slump.
Inebriated for the first time in his life, a timid young priest-to-be makes an amorous advance toward Diane and concludes he's not fit for the monastery.

programmes.st: The Spy Who Came in for a Cold One
programmes.d: Diane incurs the wrath of Sam and the entire Cheers clan when she exposes a customer who spouts captivating, tall-tales of his exploits as a World War II spy.
A casting agent pursues Sam, offering more than just a business proposition.
Saddened by the death of her cat, Diane gains little sympathy from the Cheers clan and begins to reevaluate her relationships with everyone, especially Sam.
Diane is aghast when a very pregnant Carla tricks the surprised, but ecstatic egghead Marshall Lipton into believing he's the father.
Sam's shocked when his ex-teammate comes out of the closet at the bar.
Sam unknowingly hires and ex-murderer to escort Diane on a double date.
Sam enters a photo of Diane in the annual Miss Boston Barmaid contest.
Sam tries to set up a sting to catch a crooked poker player. When Sam learns that a conman has taken thousands of dollars from Coach, he turns to Harry "The Hat" to help them get the money back.
Diane proposes marriage to Sam in order to save her mom's inheritance.
Sam is chagrined when his brother captivates everyone at Cheers, especially Diane, whose budding romance with the dashing Derek sparks Sam's jealously and confusion.
Sam and Diane are forced to come to grips with their feelings about each other when Diane's relationship with Sam's brother grows more serious.
Sam and Diane's new relationship together gets off to a shaky start, which comes as no surprise to anyone at the bar.
While Carla's in labor, her promiscuous sister goes on the prowl at Cheers.
Diane takes another job when Carla complains that she's getting special treatment.
Scary things are afoot in this Halloween-themed boot camp.
Celebrity recruits are put to the test and teams must replicate a recipe.
The remaining celebrities turn the tables and give their mentors a lesson.
The celebrity recruits cook a simple recipe that's missing some key words.
The last two recruits cook a restaurant-quality meal for culinary experts.
We revisit the craziest and messiest moments in the show's history!
Two hopeless cooks want to host a holiday dinner for their entire family.
The recruits kick off boot camp with a shrimp and live lobster challenge.
The teams get cracking with the most important meal of the day: breakfast.
The recruits learn about flavor and cook with international ingredients.
The recruits face their fears by learning how to prepare a fish dinner.
The recruits must prepare the ultimate game-day sandwich and appetizer.

programmes.st: The Proof Is in the Pudding
programmes.d: The recruits learn how to make a decadent dessert for Valentine's Day.
The recruits must face their food fears by using obscure ingredients.
The recruits tackle the flavors and techniques of New Orleans cuisine.
The tables turn as the final recruits coach their mentors to make a dish.
Two recruits must prepare a restaurant-quality meal in the final challenge.
Relive the funniest moments as the mentors transform hopeless cooks.
Mentors Anne Burrell and Rachael Ray teach the celebs how to cook lobster.
The mentors play a taste-and-describe game with the celebrity recruits.
The celebrities learn how to make classic crepes in Cafe Worst Cooks.

programmes.st: Celebrity: Around the World in a Day
programmes.d: The recruits have to make their own hand-pulled noodles from scratch.
An older family camp is in need of some modern upgrades.
A family needs help to fulfill their dream of a home by the slopes.
The crew builds out a brand new woodshop and revamps their headquarters.
The Maine Cabin Masters help out with a geodesic dome.
The Cabin Masters plot a secret holiday gift for Chase.
The Maine Cabin Masters update a pair of cabins right on the water.
This family camp was in great shape, until a tree fell onto its roof!
The Masters take on a 1930s waterside cottage overdue for an upgrade.
The Maine Cabin Masters help build a tiny house for disadvantaged youth.
A growing family needs more space at their camp on Pocasset Lake.
The gang helps an all-star sports broadcaster in need of a new bunkhouse.
Chase and team completely redesign the floorplan of a Damariscotta camp.
The Maine Cabin Masters help old friends whose house suffered fire damage.
The crew returns to their old high school to build an outdoor classroom.
A man enlists the team to make his cabin on the water more comfortable.
Welcome to Elizabeth Poett's family ranch in Central California.
Elizabeth celebrates springtime with fried chicken and lemon cake.
Elizabeth prepares hummingbird cake and brisket sandwiches for her crew.
Elizabeth serves herb focaccia and pork ribs for her cousin's family.
Elizabeth catches and serves fresh fish for a date night with her husband.
Elizabeth makes fresh jam for a strawberry shortcake dessert.
Elizabeth prepares rib eye steaks and walnut cake for her close friends.
Elizabeth makes tomato soup and a chocolate cake to warm up on a rainy day.
Elizabeth prepares arroz con pollo and lemon meringue pie for her parents.
Elizabeth makes pistachio cinnamon rolls and a chicken pot pie for workers.
Producer-director Otto Preminger’s epic treatment of the bombing of Pearl Harbor details the devastating attack on the Hawaiian naval base as well as the explosive, behind-the-scenes stories.
Bogart plays an escaped con who has nothing to lose. March is a suburban Everyman who has everything to lose - his family is held hostage by Bogart.

Café busboy Walter ventures into the world of sculpting with a small statue called Dead Cat. Unfortunately, Dead Cat is followed by Murdered Man. By the time we reach Walter’s interest in the female form...well, you get the picture.
Jack Lemmon, Shirley MacLaine and Fred MacMurray are superb in this tale of love and ambition in the world of big business that went on to garner a Best Picture Oscar.
After marrying a soldier during a wild night on the town, a small-town girl suffers amnesia and can't remember anything about the man she married.
Jerry Lewis directed, co-wrote and starred in this riotously funny movie that set a new standard for screen comedy and inspired the hit remake.

Raised as an Egyptian prince, Moses (Charlton Heston) discovers his Hebrew heritage, hears God's call, and engages in a bitter battle with the Pharaoh Ramses (Yul Brynner) to free the Jews from slavery, leading them to the Promised Land.

Max Von Sydow, John Wayne, Charlton Heston, Sidney Poitier, and Shelley Winters head an all-star cast in this lavish portrayal of the life of Jesus from legendary director George Stevens. This stunning epic truly is The Greatest Story Ever Told.

programmes.st: How To See South America By Bus
programmes.d: When a lovely, young and successful farmer comes to Oliver (Eddie Albert) for his legal counsel, Lisa (Eva Gabor) quickly becomes jealous of the two spending time together and becomes determined to break up what she sees as a budding romance.

Ring the bells! Spread the word! Latka Gravas and Simka Dahblitz are getting married, and the dingy Sunshine Cab Co. garage is transformed into a chapel of beauty for the social event of the cabbies' season.
The unflappable Jim gets an unexpected jolt when a wrecking ball crashes through the wall of his condemned apartment. A disaster ensues when he is forced to move in with Louie.
The drivers bare their souls, recalling those moments in their lives when fate caused them to detour from the street of dreams down the alley to becoming a cabbie.
As Elaine nears a decision on her future, the cabbies reminisce about those glorious things that "might have been" had fate not sent them down that treacherous road to the Sunshine Cab Co.
Reverend Jim comes to the rescue when Alex is consumed by gambling fever after a lucky night in Atlantic City.
When Simka learns that Latka has been unfaithful, she is bound by tradition to do the same thing with one of Latka's fellow cabbies.
After Latka has an affair with a female cabbie, Simka must do the same with one of his co-workers.
Jeff ends up in serious trouble after he confesses to stealing from the garage to protect the real villain.
Mike and Robbie take a song to a New York publicist.
Ernie and Chip reenact "Tom Sawyer."
Steve must take in a delinquent as a houseguest for a week.
Steve has to go to Japan for business and decides to bring the boys along.
Robbie and his friend Hank need money to go on dates, so they decide to start a business for home repairs and outdoor chores.
Tramp gets framed.
An unexpected visitor catches Steve by surprise.
Chip sees a ghost while trick-or-treating.
All of the Douglases fall in love at the same time.
Chip has no mother to provide a recipe for a contest.

When the Monroe Brothers show up to fix the Douglas's closet, Lisa learns that Ralph is devastated because her true love has stood her up on another date. Lisa's solution: an intensive, two-day beauty treatment for Ralph…and the barn for Oliver!

programmes.st: One Of Our Assemblymen Is Missing
programmes.d: Oliver (Eddie Albert) takes to his soap box, delivering fiery, patriotic speeches after getting a bill from the State Farm Unattached Duty Tax for an outrageous $12.03! But no one can figure out why the tax is levied in the first place.

Lisa (Eva Gabor) is curious to learn about the book that Oliver (Eddie Albert) is reading. It is the real-life story of pioneers Gus and Etta Thompson. The episode flashes back to the 19th century with Oliver appearing as Gus and Lisa as Etta.

programmes.st: Eb Discovers The Birds And The Bees
programmes.d: Eb (Tom Lester) seeks dating advice from the Douglas's after laying eyes on former classmate Betty Jo Bradley from petticoat Junction. Oliver's well-intentioned guidance has mixed results when Eb hilariously misconstrues the advice he's given.

The locals complain that Oliver's penchant for wearing business suits to do farm work is ruining Hooterville's image. Oliver tries to adjust, but the last laugh is on him when Lisa has her dressmaker design Italian him some swanky new overalls.

programmes.st: You Ought To Be In Pictures
programmes.d: The Hooterville Chamber of Commerce attempts to attract a Hollywood film studio to shoot a movie in town. And when a rumor spreads that a famous actor is arriving, the townsfolk are all abuzz as they prepare for their close-up, Mr. DeMille!

programmes.st: A Home Isn't Built In A Day
programmes.d: Fed up with the house being in dire need of repair, Lisa demands that Oliver arrange to have the house redone or she's moving back to New York. Oliver agrees, but is delayed when Mr. Haney claims that their farmhouse is a historic monument.

Everything is topsy-turvy and henhouse hijinks ensue when one of the Douglas' hens is found to be laying square eggs! News of this kind gets around quickly, and the townsfolk all get in on the race to capitalize on the impressive novelty.

Oliver is absolutely determined to have a truly old-fashioned Christmas, including decorating his own farm-grown tree. But warm weather stands in the way and, he discovers, the residents of Hooterville aren't exactly as traditional as he thought.

programmes.st: Never Trust A Little Old Lady
programmes.d: In true Hooterville fashion, Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that the town is vehemently split as to which weather reporter they trust. As debates rage over which forecast is correct, Oliver plants his tomato crop, hoping for the best.
Driven by a severe case of guilt, Maude extends a less than sincere invitation to her trying aunt Tinkie, but can't possibly be prepared for the suffering yet to come.
Maude's liberal beliefs are put to test when she insists that Phillip invite his friend Sam to spend the night, only to be confronted by an unexpected situation.
A UFO has been sighted over Tuckahoe, but no one believes it because it's Maude who's spotted it.
The liberated woman has no place in society...at least that is what Victoria Butterfield's father professes and Maude protests.
"Rock star found with head smashed in empty pool" That headline would end the gravy train so his managers fake a kidnapping to salvage something, but they are unaware of a witness.

programmes.st: See Some Evil... Do Some Evil
programmes.d: A blind pianist whose sight has been restored kills his blackmail victim just before Barnaby arrives. Barnaby suspects him but must prove he can see.
A suspicious hit and run brings Barnaby to a little town where sudden riches are obvious. "Town council meetings" are a cover for plotting murder, and Barnaby is in their sights.

programmes.st: To Denise, with Love and Murder
programmes.d: A murdered mistress and a missing wife bring Barnaby Jones onto the case. The problem? Two weeks have passed, and the killer has covered his tracks.

programmes.st: A Little Glory, a Little Death
programmes.d: Barnaby investigates the death of a woman who was killed in a car accident after the woman's daughter claims that it was no accident. An aging movie star with something to hide is Barnaby's number one suspect.
Believing her baby was kidnapped, not stillborn as people claim, a mother embarks on a murderous quest to find the truth.
The killing of a cop by another cop is investigated, with the question of accidental vs. intentional up in the air.
Stone and Keller work to crack a kidnap case where the mother is the friend of an alleged psychic.
A killer and rapist is terrorizing the city, but Stone and Keller have almost no clues to lead them to the assailant.
A philandering professor is killed and his mistress is shot by a sniper who has been terrorizing a college campus.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Police Chief Bill Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Chief of Detectives Virgil Tibbs (Howard Rollins) are at odds when Tibbs suspects that Gillespie's old friend, Sonny Mims, killed his wife because of his involvement with the dead woman's cousin.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Emotions run high when a black businessman (Randy Brooks) comes to Sparta to buy the town's newspaper, and it is suspected that he is romancing the paper's married white owner (Nana Visitor). Carroll O'Connor and Howard Rollins star.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Sparta is overjoyed when a local boy turned, successful businessman offers to bring new prosperity to the Mississippi hamlet by moving his business interests back home. But all of his business interests may not be exactly legal. (Part 1 of 2)

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: After Virgil (Howard Rollins) narrowly escapes death at the hands of Ritchie Epson's henchmen, Chief Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) still does not have enough evidence to prove that former hometown boy Epson (Bill Sadler) is a major drug supplier.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: The Sparta jail descends into complete and utter chaos when the six wives of a bigamist (guest star Ted Lange) all show up to visit and shower him with gifts. But when the man turns up dead in his cell, which of his wives turns out to be a murderer?

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: An escaped convict and his girlfriend leave a trail of bodies in their wake as they travel through Mississippi and eventually take Althea and Scooter, the grandson of one of their victims, as hostages in a desperate bid for freedom.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Much to the dismay of Parker Williams, his wayward stepfather, Daddy Roy Eversole, returns to Sparta with his current girlfriend, Roda, and moves into Parker’s home. Even worse, they’re being pursued by a pair of desperate art thieves from Florida.
Richard Kimble stumbles into the intrigues of a politically ambitious man when he rescues a leading citizen and his woman companion from a plane crash.
Neuropsychiatrist Mark Ryder employs a computer and Lt. Gerard's help to plan Richard Kimble's capture.
Selected by Bravo Magazine as one of L.A.'s most eligible bachelors, Dr. Jack Stewart isn't aware the honor is dangerous to his health.
Amidst the corridors of Community General Hospital, the hit t.v. show The New Healers is shooting their next episode.
Refusing to believe that a long-time patient, Alex Forman, committed suicide, Dr. Sloan launches his own investigation.

What could be more dangerous than a psychopathic killer with a taste for revenge! Eddie Gault, recently paroled, has only one thing on his mind--making Lt. Steve Sloan suffer for putting him in prison.
Alex wakes up in the morning and finds a gun in her hand and a dead man beside her. Realizing she was framed, the Rangers investigate. Alex's father comes to town to defend her.

Joey Prado, the professional kickboxer whom Walker trained and helped when he was in trouble, has just graduated from the police academy. And he gets an assignment which has him going undercover to get a guy he knew who is now a drug dealer.
A man that Walker and others helped put into prison has escaped. He is determined to kill those responsible for his imprisonment, with Walker being the last one on his list.
An undercover detective in Miami is captured by drug dealers when her cover is blown. Miami police ask Texas Ranges to help by going undercover as out-of-town dealers looking for drugs.
A group calls themselves the Guardians and wants to blow up oil rigs because they are dangerous to the environment. Walker goes undercover to find the men at the top of the group.
MacGyver's mountain retreat group is infiltrated by a couple of murderous escaped convicts.
MacGyver unravels an assassination plot against an East African leader after discovering that Jack Dalton has been brainwashed.
MacGyver and Pete Thornton are taken hostage by a group of terrorists threatening to take over a nearby city.
MacGyver is shocked when he learns that the thief who stole a vial of deadly bacteria from the Phoenix Foundation is an old friend who once saved his life.
Searching for a new way to promote Community General, Norman Briggs decides to have the hospital sponsor a women's professional volleyball team.
It's not just another day at the beach when an investigative reporter out for her daily swim drowns. The lifeguard, Rip, is blamed for the death despite his protests of innocence.

programmes.st: The Mama Who Came to Dinner
programmes.d: Fran comes up with a way Vint and Naomi can have a dinner party. Mama is against it until Naomi says anything they could have at Mama's would be second-rate.

Mama desperately wants to go to the mall and pick up a hat she really wants, but no one can drive her. The family attempts to teach Mama to drive which is unsuccessful until Mama realizes she may lose out on her hat.
Robbie teaches American customs to a Chinese girl.
The Douglas family get an opportunity to move to Hawaii.
Chip's stone frog may indeed be magical.
Bub decides to follow his dreams of show business.

programmes.st: Fish Gotta Swim, Birds Gotta Fly
programmes.d: Mike decides to teach Sally how to fish.
Mike's Japanese ex-girlfriend comes to town.
Steve's former sweetheart is now a princess.
Bub joins a women's group to save a tree.
Mr. Wilson is named chairman of a saving-stamps campaign for the Junior Astronauts and arranges a contest at Dennis' school to win a trip to Cape Canaveral to meet an astronaut.
Mr. Wilson tells Dennis he isn't feeling well just to get Dennis to leave him alone, but Dennis of course spreads the word and leads everyone to believe that Mr. Wilson is very sick.
Mr. Wilson gives Dennis a book called Secrets Of The Indian Rain Dance, and he and his friends decide to give it a try.

programmes.st: The Creature With The Big Feet
programmes.d: Mr. Wilson sees large footprints in his yard caused by Dennis' new novelty shoes and thinks they may be from a monster that has been reported in the newspaper.
Dennis decides to help along a potential romance between an older friend of his and a new girl in town.
Dennis is appointed by the mayor to go to Washington to ask their senator to support the creation of a national forest at nearby Hickory Mountain.
The star player on Dennis' basketball team, Stretch, quits the team because Johnny Brady and some of the other players constantly make fun of him.
Mr. Wilson is convinced that he is allergic to Dennis because he sneezes every time Dennis is around.

Jan makes a bunch of promises to be elected "Most Popular Girl" in her class, but backs out of them after she wins the election. Meanwhile, Mike and Carol try to make plans for their second honeymoon.
A couple Mike and Carol know adopt a young boy, but the boy soon misses his two best friends--one African-American, one Asian-American. As a result, the couple decides to adopt all three boys.

Marcia battles nerves and Greg's sexist remarks when she tries to get her driver's license. Eventually, the debate over which gender has the better driving abilities leads to a winner-take-all driving test in a vacant parking lot.

Peter and Bobby believe they are seeing a UFO, which actually is part of an elaborate hoax being played by Greg. The trick backfires though when Peter and Bobby take pictures, which lead to a government investigation.
Cousin Oliver comes to live with the Bradys. He immediately causes a series of accidents, which lead him to believe that he is a jinx.
After Mike gets a visit from an FBI agent and Sam comes to him with some secret plans, Bobby and Oliver believe that Sam is a spy.

The Bradys get a new pool table (as a thank you gift from Mr. Matthews for Mike's recent performance). Bobby soon becomes an expert in billiards and - during a family party - beats Mike's boss in a game of pool.
Bobby needs money, so he starts selling hair tonic. Greg decides to buy a bottle right before graduation to help his little brother, but it turns his hair orange.
Carol and Mike wed and the two sets of siblings merge to one family.

programmes.st: A Club House Is Not A Home
programmes.d: The boys refuse to share their clubhouse with the girls.
The Bradys fear they will have to give away Tiger due to Jan’s allergies.
Cindy’s lead role in a school play causes a family crisis.

Naomi returns from her self-defense class and shows the family what she learned. Fran and Sonja are impressed with what Naomi does and says and decide to join. After Mama is mugged, she decides to join as well.
When Mama decides to buy her own car from Vint's childhood friend, Willie Potts, she is dismayed that the car is a lemon and demands her money back.

Mama is getting annoyed with Naomi at Food Circus and tells all her customers to go to a different checker. Mr. Palmer, the manager, gets to talking with Mama, who gives him advice, and he ends up offering her a job.
Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge.

programmes.t: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C Minor, Op. 67
programmes.d: Les Dissonances perform Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67 at Philharmonie de Paris, France, in 2015.
Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programmes.t: Beethoven: Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programmes.d: Opening with the composer's Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21; Fischer conducts Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist.

programmes.t: Mahler, The Song of the Earth
programmes.d: Leonard Bernstein was the first conductor to record all of Mahler's symphonies on disk and on video.
Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's "Goldberg Variations BWV 988" at the Leipzig Bach Festival.

Get swept away by the amazing visuals and premium sound quality of classical masterpieces! Watch breathtaking orchestral performances, operas, and ballets. Experience the grandest, most popular classical musical productions filmed around the world.

programmes.t: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
programmes.d: Get swept away by the amazing visuals and premium sound quality of classical masterpieces! Watch breathtaking orchestral performances, operas, and ballets. Experience the grandest, most popular classical musical productions filmed around the world.

programmes.t: Works for Lute by J. S. Bach
programmes.d: French lutenist Thomas Dunford performs various works for lute by J. S. Bach in this intimate chamber music concert, recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, in 2017.

programmes.t: Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programmes.d: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg’s Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31.

programmes.t: Beauty is a Crime: Mendelssohn & Brahms
programmes.d: Greek conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside Austrian-Moldovan violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians.

programmes.t: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programmes.d: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy.

programmes.t: Beethoven: Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programmes.d: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020's Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven's celebrated Symphony No 3 in E-flat major, Op 55, Eroica.

programmes.t: Gaming X Symphony: Legends & Quests in Concert
programmes.d: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, with Nordic singer Eivør as special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

Police in Albany, N.Y., get a surprise when a killer they think targets only older women is suspected in the murder of an elderly man. And the contents of a secret storage shed holds the grisly clues to a murder that has gone cold for more than 14 years.
On a bitter morning in 1980, radio intern Helene Pruszynski is found brutalized in a snowy field. After 37 years of fruitless leads, investigators tap into a genealogy website that gives them a lead.

In Rhode Island, policewomen go undercover as streetwalkers to nab the man suspected of murdering three prostitutes. And a dagger-shaped letter opener is the key piece of evidence that links a priest to the grisly 1980 murder of a nun in Ohio.
Testimony about the growth of larvae in dead bodies helps convict the man who stabbed a couple to death and strangled their 4-year-old daughter in 1993.

Police reopen a rape-murder case 25 years after the crime and find enough DNA evidence to bring him to justice. And a confession made to a "Baywatch" TV star helps police solve the three-year-old riddle of a wealthy Newport Beach woman's murder.
In Missouri, a part-time missionary is convicted, 38 years later, of killing her 5-year-old stepdaughter, and the skeleton of a Michigan boy, dead for 10 years, leads police to a serial killer.

When a deadly house fire claims the life of a family in rural Oklahoma, investigators suspect foul play and it sends a mother on a decades-long crusade to find out what happened to her missing teenage daughter and best friend.

A kidnapper grabs 8-year-old Chad Choice from his home in Texas, then torments his parents with two ransom demands. The case goes cold until the parents receive a chilling package in the mail that contains a letter--and a skull.
A look at the case of James Allen Selby, a serial rapist who eluded police for years while attacking 11 women in five states - Oklahoma, Nevada, California, Arizona, and Colorado.

The killing of a woman in a VA goes unsolved for a quarter of a century before investigators are finally able to zero in on the likely killer. And, in 1999 detectives test the blood evidence and develop a DNA profile of a shooting death from 1980.
A woman's fall from a cliff in the Grand Canyon leads police to uncover a series of grisly murders, and investigators smoke out a killer when they find crucial DNA evidence on his cigarette butts.
Halloween in a small town is canceled indefinitely when a young girl is kidnapped and killed on her way home from a costume party.

programmes.st: In The Care Of A Killer/Deadly Lies
programmes.d: The suspicious death of 2-year-old Billy Blankenship is solved when police force his babysitter to re-enact the circumstances of his death. Then, a murder case is solved when the dead man's body is accidentally found by divers.

A serial rapist seals his own fate when he sends a taunting letter to police. And when a man is found dead in South Dakota, his head bashed in by a 50-pound rock, investigators go on a 20-year search for the killers.
College student Brad Perry shows up to work his graveyard shift at the gas station and is never seen alive again.
When 25-year-old school teacher Christy Mirack is found murdered in her apartment in 1992, there is no shortage of suspects.

Just two years into their marriage, Chuck and Cheryl Hall are torn apart when Chuck finds Cheryl murdered. Though Cheryl's family is certain they know her killer, the law isn't as sure. After several decades, a DNA match erases all doubt.
Navy officer Douglas Hegdahl outwits his captors when he's taken as a POW in North Vietnam, and Florence Nightingale revolutionizes the field of nursing.
Mary Mallon spreads typhoid fever wherever she goes, and Cleopatra's younger sister Arsinoe schemes her way in and out of power in Ancient Egypt.

Mary Dyer wages war with the Puritan establishment, two cunning thieves pull off a $500 million art heist, & the most notorious arsonist in New England history is revealed. Guest starring: Winona Ryder, Michael Cera, Nick Offerman.

Woodward and Bernstein blow open the Watergate scandal, actors/brothers Edwin and John Wilkes Booth engage in a tragic feud, and Elvis crashes the White House to meet Nixon. Guest starring Jack Black, Dave Grohl, Bob Odenkirk.

Al Capone gets destroyed by an unlikely enemy, prairie lawyer Abraham Lincoln gets a huge break, and the police go to war with protestors during the Haymarket Riot. Guest starring Ike Barinholtz, Joe Lo Truglio, Matt Besser.

John Pemberton invents Coca-Cola from wine and cocaine, the FBI tries to take down Martin Luther King Jr., and Stetson Kennedy infiltrates the Ku Klux Klan. Guest starring Bill Hader, Simon Helberg, Kevin Nealon and more.
Patty Hearst gets kidnapped and brainwashed, Mark Twain flees the city in fear and finds his unlikely first hit story. Guest starring Kristen Wiig, Terry Crews, Lisa Bonet and more.

Ralph Nader goes to war with General Motors, Houdini and Sir Arthur Conan Doyle go from best friends to bitter rivals, and the Kellogg Brothers invent cereal but battle each other. Guest starring Owen Wilson, Alfred Molina, Jason Schwartzman and more.

Hold-outs fight to the bitter end at the Alamo, Billy the Kid goes on the run from lawman Pat Garrett, and Teddy Roosevelt rounds up the Rough Riders and goes to war. Guest starring Jake Johnson, Chris Parnell, Andy Daly and more.

Lewis and Clark explore the dangerous west, evolution is questioned in the controversial "trial of the century," and Dolly Parton has to leave the man who made her famous. Guest starring Tony Hale, Aubrey Plaza, Jack McBrayer and more.
The guys get busted for smoking pot and attend a Narcotics Anonymous meeting, where Blake runs into an old friend and Ders makes a scary new one.
The guys celebrate Ders Day at a Viking Museum, and Adam and Blake become obsessed with trying to pull off a heist.
Blake comes up with a brilliant moneymaking idea in order to enter a timber sports tournament.
Alice's freewheeling sister visits the TelAmeriCorp office and teaches the guys how to please a woman.
The guys search for drugs, lose their clothes and try to impress girls during a weekend at TelAmeriCorp's beach condo.
During a getaway to a remote mountain cabin, the guys suspect that their wealthy hosts aren't what they seem.
When the guys take three young trainees under their wing, the office prank situation gets seriously out of hand.
Bill and Montez transport a mysterious briefcase through the Chinatown underworld.
When Alice makes the office sell a terrible product that her dad invented, the guys discover they can use it as a cover to deal weed over the phone.
The guys throw their own version of Coachella to impress some girls.
Best friends Sam and Tim work on an advertising pitch for Chrysler, but they run into problems with the company's vice president of marketing.
An adventuresome client inspires Sam and Tim to ditch the office and cruise around on their newly purchased motorcycle.
Sam accidentally becomes a prostitute, and Tim comes down with a bad case of colitis.
Tim and Sam try to convince a Motown legend to sing a jingle for a local wig company.
At Mr. Duvet's 60th birthday party, Sam feels the pressure to impress his dad with a great speech.
Sam and Tim's friendship is tested after a trendy new company moves into the building.
After being dumped by a client, Sam and Tim court a competitor in a bid for revenge.
When Lea demands that the guys pay for her health insurance, they go on a journey around town to scrape together money from outstanding debts.
When Tim's dad returns from the psychiatric hospital, the guys find themselves reduced to junior status at Cramblin Duvet.
The guys become wracked with guilt after running into Carter Grant at the local advertising awards ceremony.
Cramblin Duvet hits a hot streak, and Sam and Tim help Sheila find a lawyer after she gets a DUI.
Tension builds between Sam and Tim after Sam acts in one of their commercials, and Sheila's relationship with Lea becomes strained after she makes an off-color joke.
Sam takes the reigns as grill master at the Duvet family reunion, and Tim considers whether he might be too hard on Sam's girlfriends.

programmes.st: You Stole My $2,400 And Spent It At A Strip Club!
programmes.d: After meeting online and moving in together, Katherine is suing Michael for stealing money to use at a strip club.

programmes.t: Karamo: 47 Years ... Are We Sisters?; DNA & Unlock: Decade of Deception?
