programmes.st: HANCOCK'S CONFESSION--  THE SISTERS' ABHORRENT PAST
programmes.d: News of Luffy's run-in with the Celestial Dragons impresses the Snake Princess, so she tells him the story of her tortured past. Will his honorable nature speed Luffy toward a reunion with his crew?

programmes.st: SAVING ACE! THE NEXT STOP: THE GREAT PRISON
programmes.d: Luffy is mobbed by a hoard of pretty Kuja women eager to touch a real live man. Granny Nyon offers him a safe haven, but what she has to say might sink his plans for a Straw Hat reunion.

programmes.st: LOVE IS A HURRICANE! LOVE-LOVE HANCOCK
programmes.d: Boa Hancock's illness threatens to sabotage Luffy's rescue mission. However, the Snake Princess just can't say "no" to the rubber-man, so a plan to save Ace is quickly hatched.

programmes.st: THE FRIENDS' WHEREABOUTS! THE SCIENCE OF WEATHER AND THE MECHANICAL ISLAND
programmes.d: While Luffy races to save Ace, Nami tries to survive life on Sky Island, and Franky dances up a snowstorm before making the switch from cola to tea!

programmes.st: THE FRIENDS' WHEREABOUTS! AN ISLAND OF GIANT BIRDS AND A PINK PARADISE!
programmes.d: Chopper narrowly avoids being served for dinner in a land inhabited by giant birds, and Sanji's refined tastes land him a role as a leading lady on the island of girlish hearts.

programmes.st: THE FRIENDS' WHEREABOUTS! BRIDGING THE ISLANDS AND VICIOUS VEGETATION!
programmes.d: Nico Robin finds herself trapped on the island of Tequila Wolf: a miserable land where children are forced to work as slaves. Elsewhere, Usopp tries to survive a run-in with a man-eating plant!

programmes.st: THE FRIENDS' WHEREABOUTS! A NEGATIVE PRINCESS AND THE KING OF DEMONS!
programmes.d: Zoro is held against his will by the pink-haired princess of bad vibes, Brook gets mistaken for the king of darkness, and Luffy continues to eat his way toward a reunion with Fire-Fist Ace!

programmes.st: A DEADLY INFILTRATION! THE UNDERWATER PRISON IMPEL DOWN
programmes.d: Luffy and Boa arrive at Impel Down, but only thirty-three hours remain until Ace's execution. To save him, the Snake Princess must find a way to hide Luffy during her full-body search!

programmes.st: A REUNION IN HELL?! THE MAN WHO ATE THE CHOP-CHOP FRUIT!
programmes.d: Time is running out on Ace, so Luffy teams up with a scoundrel who's going to pieces trying to escape Impel Down. There's no love lost between the former foes, but they'd better work together if they want to survive.

programmes.st: BREAK THROUGH THE CRIMSON HELL! BUGGY'S CHAOS-INDUCING PLAN
programmes.d: Luffy must part ways with a priceless treasure map before Buggy the Clown agrees to lead him through the bloody tangle of Blade Trees and Spike Needle Grass that make up Impel Down's Crimson Hell!

programmes.st: THE STRONGEST MAN IN THE PRISON! POISON MAN MAGELLAN APPEARS
programmes.d: Luffy and Buggy the Clown could end up as hippo food if they aren't careful in Impel Down's Wild Beast Hell. Of course, the rubber-man might find that a better fate than dealing with the prison's putrid warden!

programmes.st: A SPECIAL PRESENTATION RELATED TO THE MOVIE /  A GOLD LION'S AMBITION ON THE MOVE
programmes.d: Luffy and his crew stumble upon a most peculiar village when they hitch a ride on a fire-breathing beetle. The natives are petrified of pirates, but they welcome the Straw Hats with open arms!

programmes.st: A SPECIAL PRESENTATION RELATED TO THE MOVIE / LITTLE EAST BLUE IN DANGER
programmes.d: The citizens of Little East Blue throw in a feast in honor of the Straw Hats, but when the Amigo Pirates try to capture Boss the Beetle, Luffy and his crew will have to defend their new friends.

programmes.st: A SPECIAL PRESENTATION RELATED TO THE MOVIE / THE FIERCE ONSLAUGHT OF THE AMIGO PIRATES
programmes.d: Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji prepare to do battle on behalf of Boss the Beetle, but Captain Largo of the Amigo Pirates counters with a deadly arsenal of nets to put the Straw Hat brawlers on lock down!

programmes.st: A Special Presentation Related to the Movie/ The Battle is on! Luffy Vs. Largo
programmes.d: Luffy kicks into Second Gear for his rematch with Largo, and Nami leads the islanders as they lay waste to the Amigo Pirates. Boss the Beetle may be safe for now, but someone sinister lurks behind the scenes.

programmes.st: A Warlord in Prison Jimbei, The Honorable Pirate
programmes.d: Luffy struggles to stay a step ahead of a prison patrol made up of hungry lions and poisonous scorpions! Meanwhile, Ace spends what could be his final hours swapping stories with a pirate who hates pirates.

programmes.st: The Trap of Chief Guard Saldeath - Level 3 Starvation Hell
programmes.d: While the guards struggle to squelch a violent prison uprising, Luffy and his fellow fugitives try to keep their cool in a level of Impel Down known as Starvation Hell!

programmes.st: The Liberated Swan! Reunion! Bon Kurei
programmes.d: Boa Hancock uses her ample assets to buy some private time for a clandestine chat with Ace. Meanwhile, Luffy needs help from a graceful friend to escape the jaws of a hungry Sphinx!

programmes.st: Chief Warden Magellan Moves - The Net to Trap Straw Hat Is Complete!
programmes.d: Luffy and Bon are on the verge of reaching Level 4, but they didn't count on fighting a demonic, lightning-fast, devastatingly powerful Minotaur! To defeat this beast, they'll need help from a human candle and a deranged clown!

programmes.st: Preparations for War! A Decisive Battle in Level 4 - Blazing Hell
programmes.d: Luffy narrowly avoids a deadly dip in the boiling pool of blood, only to find himself face to face with Warden Magellan. Meanwhile, outside the prison walls, the marine fleet prepares for Whitebeard's onslaught!

programmes.st: Magellan's Strength! Bon Kurei Flees Before His Enemy
programmes.d: Warden Magellan is a monster of a man with a penchant for poisoning prisoners. To rescue Ace, Luffy must go toe to toe with this toxic terror, but how do you defeat a foe who's deadly to the touch?

programmes.st: THE SHOWDOWN HAS COME! LUFFY'S DESPERATE LAST ATTACK!
programmes.d: Luffy's daring assault on the venomous warden of Impel Down leaves him struggling to stand up, but despite the lethal poison breaking down his body, the rubber-man kicks his rescue mission into Second Gear!

programmes.st: FOR HIS FRIEND! BON CLAY'S DEADLY RESCUE ATTEMPT
programmes.d: While Luffy hovers perilously on the verge of death, Bon Clay embarks on a suicidal rescue mission plagued by sub-zero temperatures and bloodthirsty wolves with a supremely savage disposition!

programmes.st: A PARADISE IN HELL / IMPEL DOWN LEVEL 5.5
programmes.d: No existing antidote can save Luffy from the poison coursing through his veins, yet Bon Clay refuses to give up. His final, fleeting hope is a mysterious miracle-worker rumored to have vanished into the Gates of Hell!

programmes.st: LUFFY'S TREATMENT BEGINS / IVA'S MIRACULOUS POWER!
programmes.d: Bon is overjoyed to hear that Luffy is still alive, but his happiness quickly turns to shock when he learns that Ivan's agonizingly painful "Healing Hormones" will cost the rubber-man ten years of his life!

programmes.st: BELIEVE IN MIRACLES! BON CLAY'S CRIES FROM THE HEART
programmes.d: Ace is scheduled to be executed in a matter of hours, and Luffy's still hovering on the verge of death. It will take a miracle to save them both, but Bon would rather die than give up on his friend!

programmes.st: LUFFY BACK IN ACTION! IVA BEGINS THE BREAKOUT PLAN!!
programmes.d: Luffy miraculously survived his brush with death, but he's far too weak to finish rescuing Ace. Ivan is reluctant to lend a hormonal hand to the doomed rescue mission – until he learns of Luffy's lineage!

programmes.st: ACE'S CONVOY BEGINS / BATTLE ON THE LOWEST FLOOR, LEVEL 6!
programmes.d: The quest to rescue Ace tuckers out thanks to a blast of sleeping gas! Ivan's scissor-handed sidekick puts an end to nap time, but Luffy will have to join forces with a scar-faced foe from the past if he wants to complete his mission!

programmes.st: THE ULTIMATE TEAM IS FORMED / SHAKING IMPEL DOWN!
programmes.d: Luffy's desperate attempt to rescue Ace is bolstered by two powerful new allies: the murderous Crocodile and the honorable fishman Jinbei. Meanwhile, Ivan sparks a prison riot to create a diversion for the rubber-man.

programmes.st: EVEN MORE CHAOS! BLACKBEARD TEACH INVADES
programmes.d: Luffy and his gang of outlaws cause a commotion on Level Four, Blackbeard's arrival leads to the release of the prison's most feared inmate, and Ace gazes upon the great blue sky for what could be the very last time!

programmes.st: THE DANGEROUS ENCOUNTER! BLACKBEARD AND SHIRYU OF THE RAIN!
programmes.d: Ivan undergoes a curvaceous transformation to better battle sadistic Sadie, the commander of the Demon Guards. Meanwhile, Blackbeard and Shiryu head for a showdown on Level 1!

programmes.st: REFUSAL TO BE DEFEATED! SERIOUS HANNYABAL
programmes.d: Luffy's bone-crushing battle with the Vice Warden of Impel Down is interrupted by the sudden appearance of Blackbeard. When the rubber-man hears what the warlord has to say – heads will roll!

programmes.st: JET PISTOL OF ANGER! LUFFY VS. BLACKBEARD!
programmes.d: Even in Second Gear, Luffy is no match for Blackbeard's vortex, but the rubber-man rebounds by knocking out a Demon Guard with one ferocious pistol-punch. Elsewhere, Warden Magellan vows to finish Luffy once and for all!

Gibbs and the team rush to a scene where a high-level intelligence officer was murdered, only to discover that the crime took place three days earlier and was "investigated" by the local authorities.

After 10 kilograms of highly toxic chemical weapons go missing, Gibbs and his team scramble to locate it. The NCIS team is horrified when they discover that the deadly chemical weapon is now held by wanted terrorist Mamoun Sharif.

After capturing one international arms dealer, the NCIS team discovers that the Navy's highly classified weapons system is about to be sold to another high priority arms dealer known as "La Grenouille" (Armand Assante).

Gibbs and the team collaborate with an inspector for the International Atomic Energy Agency suffering from radiation poisoning, recreating his routine in an effort to figure out when the contamination took place.

programmes.d: For people who live on active volcanoes, life has an element of impermanence to it. There is always the fear that one day their turn will come, and their home will be in the path of the volcano.

With approximately 130 active volcanoes, Indonesia is arguably the most active place on earth. Volcanologist Tom Pfeiffer leads an expedition to some of Indonesia most remote and rarely visited volcanos.

Volcanic folklore is reflected in Mexican history. One of their ancient legends tells the story of the Aztec warrior Popocatépetl - a giant active volcano - who erupts to wake his sleeping princess Iztaccíhuatl, a neighboring extinct ice capped volcano.

We see how science helps us prepare for natural disasters.

Ursula goes ape at an auction when Roy says her coat makes her look like a monkey. Paul and Bogart set a bad example for returning buyer Jeff Gardner and his son. It takes a lot for Rick and Cindy to bid on their locker and Roy's out for blood.

Roy brings noisemakers to an auction in Emery Village but the other buyers aren't feeling it. Rick and Cindy prefer to clown around on their own time. Paul and Bogart boogie with some intergalactic performers, and all Ursula wants is a strong coffee.

programmes.st: May The Schwarz Be With You
programmes.d: Jeff Schwarz, aka “The Liquidator,” is back and is causing as much chaos as possible.

Paul's daughters return for an auction and decide to work as a team of their own, which ruins the day for Bogart. Roy hopes it doesn't cost him a locker. Rick and Cindy get serious about fitness and Ursula meets soprano Lindsay Sutherland Boal.

Ursula 'bro's out' at an auction in Ajax where she runs into buyers Mike and Armando. Bogart wears an eye-patch to cover an injury. Rick and Cindy do some basic training. Mike and Armando go for a spin with ice racing champion Anthony Barlow.
Cindy comes to an auction in Toronto with voodoo dolls of the other buyers. Rick's not convinced but knows better than to question Cindy.

Bogart sets out to make an “extreme locker buying” video at an auction in North Toronto with cameras on his and Paul's heads. Ursula looks even more glamorous, Rick and Cindy get their groom on, and Roy scores a date with Olympian Elizabeth Manley.

programmes.st: All's Well That Ends Wildly Ridiculous
programmes.d: Roy hires impersonators of the buyers at an auction. Paul and Bogart bond as they evade them. Rick and Cindy keep searching lockers and former NHL player Jim Thomson helps them find The Great One. Roy and Ursula's friendship blooms.
For the professional bidders, Aurora is a symphony of minor letdowns and major scores.
In Orangeville Rick and Cindy rock it, Paul and Bogart blow it, and Ursula goes bid crazy.
Brampton is a series of twists and turnarounds, where every locker contains a surprise package containing more - and less – than meets the eye.
It’s round robin mind-games when Ursula outsmarts Roy…who outsmarts Cindy…who outsmarts Paul and Bogart, who not so smartly make a bad decision.
A research expedition to a French castle and prison reveals new clues, including ancient carvings that strengthen a possible link between the Knights Templar and Oak Island.
The team unearths a ship's log detailing the burial of treasure on an island eerily similar to Oak Island, and Rick and Gary make what may prove to be the biggest find on Oak Island, ever.
Kirk and Spock meet Abraham Lincoln and Surak of Vulcan and must battle with some of history's most terrible villains.
Kirk, Spock, and McCoy enter a time portal and get stuck in the past on a planet about to be consumed by a nova.
The Enterprise is in danger when Janice Lester, one of Kirk's former lovers, steals his body.
Kirk and his crew are at deadly risk from an alien creature that feeds on the salt in a human body and can take on any form.
A powerful teenage boy wreaks havoc aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise.

programmes.st: Where No Man Has Gone Before
programmes.d: Kirk's friend, Gary Mitchell, is transformed into a God-like entity.
A strange alien substance causes the crew to act out their deepest inhibitions, while the ship plummets out of orbit.

A transporter malfunction causes Captain Kirk to split into his "good" and "evil" selves, and a landing party will freeze to death if the crew is unable to find a way to merge the two Kirks back together.
The Enterprise picks up a intergalactic conman, Harry Mudd, and three incredibly beautiful women who harbor a dark secret.

programmes.st: What Are Little Girls Made Of?
programmes.d: Nurse Christine Chapel is reunited with her old fiancé on Exo III, but the scientist has plans for Captain Kirk and the Federation.
A strange group of children are discovered on an Earth-like planet.
Kirk investigates an experimental facility for holding prisoners and finds a sinister scheme.
Kirk bluffs his way past what appears to be a powerful alien.
Spock hijacks the Enterprise to return an injured Captain Pike to Talos IV.
Spock hijacks the Enterprise to return an injured Captain Pike to Talos IV.
Kirk is one of the last survivors who can identify a mass killer, who lurks among a Shakespearean troupe aboard the Enterprise.
The Enterprise must decide on its response when a Romulan ship makes a destructively hostile armed probe of Federation territory.
Misdiagnosed with a terminal disease, Quark sells his body parts on the Ferengi market to pay off his debts, then finds himself unable to break the contract.
Odo is forced to return to the homeworld of his people and face judgment for killing one of his own.
Sisko, Odo, O'Brien, and Worf enter Klingon territory on a suicide mission to expose Gowron, the Klingon leader, as a Changeling.
A severely injured crewmember's life hangs in the balance as Sisko battles for control of a crashed Jem'Hadar warship.

programmes.st: Looking For Par'mach In All The Wrong Places
programmes.d: Worf helps Quark woo a visiting Klingon woman, even though he is in love with her.
Trapped on a planet under Klingon attack, Jake Sisko panics in the heat of battle.
Sisko travels back in time to a pivotal moment in the history of the original Starship Enterprise.
A strange entity takes over Keiko's body and orders O'Brien to complete a secret assignment -- or his wife will be killed.

programmes.st: Let He Who Is Without Sin...
programmes.d: While vacationing on the planet Risa, Worf falls under the influence of a traditionalist group bent on destroying the pleasure paradise.
Sisko, Odo, Dax, and Garak are mysteriously placed into the roles of a group of condemned Bajorans executed seven years ago.
Stranded on a desolate planet, longtime adversaries Odo and Quark must rely on each other to survive.
Sisko is plagued by life-threatening visions that may hold the key to Bajor's future.
A mysterious assassin targets the members of Kira's resistance cell for execution.
While Kira gives birth, Odo raises an infant, Changeling.
Sisko risks everything to capture a former crewmember who deceived him and joined the Maquis.
While Worf and Garak are imprisoned in the Gamma Quadrant, Sisko learns of a Dominion invasion.
Led by Gul Dukat, Cardassia joins the Dominion and prepares to take over the Alpha Quadrant.
Enterprise is swallowed by an otherworldly vessel occupied by noncorporeal creatures who seek to trade consciousnesses with the crew members.
Archer stands accused before a Klingon tribunal charged for conspiring against the Empire, a crime that could land him a lifetime sentence on Rura Penthe.
While Enterprise investigates a planetary phenomenon, Mayweather takes the opportunity to visit the cargo ship where he was born and raised.
Enterprise is asked to evacuate a group of Denobulan geologists from a world that has been taken over by a militant faction.
Enterprise encounters a race called the Vissians who feature a third sex of "cogenitors" who are treated as second-class citizens.
An arctic research team discovers debris from an alien vessel buried in a glacier along with the bodies of two cybernetically enhanced humanoids.
While Enterprise is investigating a nebula, Archer hears that A.G. Robinson, his old rival in the early days of the NX test program, has died.
A Tellarite bounty hunter captures Archer intending to turn him over to the Klingons for a substantial reward.
When a probe from an unknown alien source unleashes a devastating assault upon Earth, Enterprise is first recalled to Earth, then sent to search for the perpetrators.
Captain Archer and his crew set out to gain information about the mysterious and antagonistic Xindi race.
Enterprise starts experiencing effects of the spatial distortions pervading the Delphic Expanse and falls victim to predatory aliens.
On a mission to investigate an abandoned Xindi vessel on a jungle planet, Archer, Reed and Hoshi succumb to a virus that mutates them into a primal life form.
The NX-01 gets closer to a showdown with the Xindi when Captain Archer takes on an enigmatic passenger: a beautiful slave named Rajiin.
When Enterprise responds to a distress call from a Vulcan ship stranded in the Delphic Expanse, Archer and his boarding team are attacked by insane zombie-like Vulcans.
A powerful telepath makes contact with Hoshi and offers to help Enterprise find the Xindi... for a price.
Archer, Reed and Major Hayes infiltrate a Xindi-Sloth industrial colony to learn more about the weapon of mass destruction that will be used against Earth.
A spatial distortion leaves Archer unable to form any new long-term memories. Years in the future, he wakes up one morning and is stunned to learn the outcome of the human-Xindi conflict.
After Data learns of his own death in late-19th-century San Francisco, a freak accident transports him back to that period.
The Enterprise crew travels between the 19th and 24th centuries in an attempt to prevent Data's death in 19th century San Francisco.
A young Enterprise engineer is forced to confront his paralyzing fear of being transported.
Troi is drastically transformed when a visiting ambassador secretly uses her to achieve his aims.
Trapped in limbo for 75 years, Star Trek's Scotty awakens to join the Next Generation in the 24th century.
Commander Riker's inability to fall asleep begins to show in other members of the crew in other forms, putting the Enterprise on the trail of a mystery.
When an honor student in the medical field is assigned to the Enterprise in an internship manner, she begins to demonstrate powers of the Q, prompting you-know-who to show up.
An emergency beam out renders four crewmen down to childhood shortly before renegade Ferengi take over the Enterprise and offload the adults.
A Holodeck fantasy goes awry, sending Worf and his son into a Wild West showdown with a villain who's a dead ringer for Data.
Data risks Picard and Geordi's lives in order to protect another living machine.
After resigning his command to participate in a dangerous secret mission, Captain Picard is taken hostage by the Cardassians.
While under the command of an unfeeling new captain, the Enterprise attempts to rescue Picard from the Cardassians.
A calculating Sherlock Holmesian character traps Picard and others in a holodeck simulation.
Geordi is enamored with a beautiful and mysterious Starfleet lieutenant accused of murder.
Forced to impersonate a Romulan Intelligence official, Counselor Troi becomes a pivotal part of an elaborate defection scheme.
After Picard loses his life in a surprise attack, Q gives him the chance to change his destiny.
Worf and Data embark on unusual journeys to seek out their fathers.
Seven and Chakotay stumble upon a race of primitive humanoids isolated from technological progress by an energy barrier.
Neelix is faced with the decision of a lifetime when Voyager locates a tribe of exiled Talaxians on a distant asteroid.
Janeway is held hostage by aliens who force the Doctor to help them steal Voyager's warp core.
Voyager's quest to return home is aided by a visitor from the future – Admiral Kathryn Janeway.
Janeway risks Voyager's shortcut home in order to destroy the Borg and save millions of lives.
Janeway's actions could cost the crew their chance of reaching home.
The pupil becomes the teacher when a Borg drone is born on Voyager and Seven of Nine instructs him in the ways of humanity.
A need to test herself leads Torres down a path of self-destruction.
The Voyager crew discovers an alien training ground for the destruction of Earth.
Neelix balks at telling Naomi that her mother and others have gone missing on an away mission.
Fifteen years after making a horrible mistake, Kim attempts to rewrite history.
Seven experiences the Borg version of multiple personality disorder.
Torres is forced to put her life in the hands of a mortal enemy that uses biochemical secretions to give commands.
Paris is confined to the Brig after interfering with the affairs of an alien race.
Janeway falls for a man who may be using her to take over Voyager.
Someone is trying to keep the Doctor from remembering the incidents surrounding a crewmember's death.
Janeway and Paris join forces to defeat the evil Doctor Chaotica.

With Atlantis plagued by an amnesia-causing virus, McKay wakes up with no idea who he is or what is going on. Following instructions from a video he recorded earlier, McKay frees himself and sets out to find the key to unlocking this mystery.

Arriving on New Athos for an overnight visit, Teyla and Dr. Keller discover the entire settlement abandoned and their own lives in jeopardy from the Bola Kai, a fierce warrior tribe. The pair must avoid capture until Atlantis sends a search party.

With still no trace of the Athosians, Teyla requests an off-world visit to meet with a seer, Davos, who may be able to help her find her people. Meanwhile on Atlantis, Agent Woolsey arrives to observe and review Col. Carter.

After working for countless hours on the Replicator coding, Dr. McKay reluctantly admits that he needs help from his sister, Jeanie. But she goes missing, McKay travels to Earth determined to find her and uncover who is behind the kidnapping.

As Dr. McKay struggles to figure out why the stargate has been inoperable, a mysterious probe plunges into the city. A sweep of the probe offers McKay a shocking glimpse of nanite code before his diagnostic program crashes and all the data is lost.

Armed with the means to track Replicator ships, the Atlantis team strives to eliminate the Replicators once and for all. Now, the team rushes to evacuate those human settlements in the path of the advancing Replicator forces.

The Atlantis long-range sensors detect the signal of a subspace tracking device familiar to Dr. McKay. The team follows to signal to a damaged hive ship drifting in space. Amidst the ship’s records, they discover references to a secret Wraith base.

Dwindling supplies, tedious routines, and low morale continue to plague the crew of the Destiny when the ship suddenly drops out of FTL and enters the orbit of an uncharted star. But, for the first time, the countdown clock doesn’t activate!

Disregarding orders, Dr. Rush links himself to the Destiny’s computer via the neural interface chair, hoping it will reveal the code needed to control Destiny’s flight path. Learning of this, Col. Young struggles with letting Rush risk his life.

Trapped beneath ruins in an underground maze, some of the Destiny's crew are stranded when the ship jumps back into FTL. The situation grows even more desperate when Rush (Robert Carlyle) learns that Destiny will soon be leaving the galaxy!

With crew members stranded, Destiny continues to cross from the present galaxy into the next one. Unable to alter the Destiny's course, Dr. Rush calculates the Destiny will fall short of making it to the next galaxy, stranding them indefinitely.

Stargate Command is baffled by the arrival of several virtually identical SG-1 teams and must find a way to return them to their respective universes before calamity occurs. Ben Browder, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, and Christopher Judge star.

Daniel fears the worst when Teal'c mysteriously disappears after investigating corruption. His fears are confirmed when he finds that Jaffa have been kidnapped and brainwashed. Ben Browder, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, and Christopher Judge star.

SG-1 sets out to destroy a massive and deadly weapon invented by their increasingly powerful foe, the Ori. If not, the Caledonian Federation and its people will be destroyed. Ben Browder, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, and Christopher Judge star.

Hank Landry (Beau Bridges) and the rest of the Stargate team plan an offensive when they learn that the Goa'uld Ba'al is in the United States and is once again regaining power. Ben Browder, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, and Christopher Judge star.

A crop of genetically engineered insects turns deadly, forcing the SG-1 team to destroy them before they and the visiting international diplomats becoming their next victims. Ben Browder, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, and Christopher Judge star.

While Teal'c sets off to investigate foul play on a Jaffa planet, Mitchell, Carter and Daniel become out of phase while experimenting with a powerful and ancient device. Ben Browder, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, and Christopher Judge star.

Having mastered water, earth and fire, Avatar Korra is eager to begin her training in airbending, but trouble in Republic City interrupts her plans.
After hitting a snag in her airbending training with Master Tenzin, Korra pays a visit to the city's Pro Bending arena in search of inspiration.
Korra attempts to infiltrate the Equalist movement and learn more about its mysterious leader.
Korra is recruited to join Councilman Tarrlok's task force, which seeks to rid the city of Equalists by force.
Korra and her pro-bending teammates struggle to work together after romantic rivalries shake their foundation.
Korra and the Fire Ferrets ready themselves for the pro-bending championship as an evil threat looms over the arena.
Tensions mount when Korra begins to suspect an ally is working for the Equalists.

Korra attempts to understand her cryptic visions, while Tenzin and Beifong lead a search for Equalist hostages.

When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job.  His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird.  He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby.  They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey.  Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez.  The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum.  The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez.  Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway.  When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programmes.st: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programmes.d: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing.  Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programmes.st: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programmes.d: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house.  While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programmes.st: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programmes.d: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters.  In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programmes.st: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programmes.d: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room.  They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programmes.st: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programmes.d: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company.  Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch.  Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden.  Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid.  The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home.  Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.
Floyd expands his barbershop with the addition of a second barber. The new barber turns out to be a gambling bookie that Barney and Andy must catch in the act.
Opie accidentally kills a bird with a slingshot and becomes foster-mother to her three young birds.
Aunt Bee is the unwilling object of matrimony when mountaineer Briscoe Darling comes a'courting.
Ron Howard's real-life father and younger brother appear as Mayberry gets involved with a gold shipment en route to Fort Knox.
Jerry Van Dyke, brother of Dick Van Dyke guest stars as a carnival's destitute banjo player. He also proves to be an inept lawman when he is hired in Barney's Fife's absence.
A state inspector learns some unique but effective police methods employed by the Mayberry sheriff.
When Barney's over-zealousness causes him to become a laughing stock, Andy tactfully arranges for Barney to regain his status.
Deputy Barney Fife helps Opie with his schoolwork, using a teaching method all his own.
Mayberry fears disaster when the sheriff discovers that a farmer's goat has eaten a good-sized meal of dynamite.
Opie tries to win a birthday present for his father at a carnival, not realizing that the carnival shooting gallery is crooked.
Opie meets a spoiled youngster and decides his own allowance should be tripled.
Ellie Walker sets the men and women of Mayberry against each other when she runs for a seat on the town council.
A car containing a high-powered businessman breaks down in low-powered Mayberry.
When Aunt Bee snags the starring role in the Mayberry Centennial Pageant, Andy and Opie become neglected at home.
Otis slips and falls in jail and is convinced by a lawyer that he should sue the county.
Andy teaches his son how to handle a seven-year-old bully.
The Mayberry mayor demands that Andy get a crime expert from the city to help solve several cow thefts.
Rather than eat Aunt Bee's indigestible homemade pickles, Andy and Barney secretly substitute store-bought pickles in her preserving jars.
Ernest T. Bass is a would-be Romeo, who is brought into the sheriff's home in an effort to teach him some manners.
Andy is too obvious in his efforts to find out if a young lady meets his expectations.

programmes.st: Andy and Helen Have Their Day
programmes.d: Andy and Helen are supposed to have a day off but are continually interrupted at their secluded picnic spot by Barney Fife asking questions about his duties.
Andy's reputation brings a proposal from a Hollywood writer that he star in a television series as a sheriff without a gun.
Andy plays matchmaker for Barney but finds himself in difficulty when Barney misinterprets his efforts.
Barney and Thelma Lou have a lovers' quarrel. Andy tries to help but only succeeds in getting caught in the middle.
Andy has his misgivings when Aunt Bee's old beau shows up in Mayberry and tries to win her over again.
Andy takes his son Opie and several of his pals on a camping trip. Barney and Gomer tag along to help out but only succeed in getting themselves lost in the woods.
Barney decides that it's time to push Andy into matrimony, but Barney's marriage bureau collapses at a frantic dinner party.
Gossiping Gomer Pyle moves in with the sheriff when he loses his job and home at the filling station.
Andy gives the state troopers a lesson in the efficiency of a county sheriff when a dangerous criminal escapes.
Comedian Don Rickles guest stars as Newton Monroe, an itinerant peddler who seems unable to do anything right.
Andy’s diplomacy and engineering skills are required to help the Mayberry choir adjust to the recent addition of tone-deaf Barney Fife to the group.
A stranger comes to Mayberry and disrupts the life of the townspeople because he knows everyone's name and business.
Andy and Barney give a Christmas party in the jail for a prisoner and his family, and thereby convert the town scrooge.

The McCains try to be tolerant of their embittered neighbor Abel MacDonald, but they decide he's gone too far when he won't allow his injured boy to get medical treatment.

When his employer begins to suspect him of embezzlement, bookkeeper Asa Manning decides to hire a professional gunman to take care of the problem.
A drought has forced local cowhands to seek work on a railroad construction project, but executives are afraid workers will desert them if they believe an old man's claim of making rain.
Lucas McCain gives blood to save a dying man and is surprised by Marshall Torrance's odd behavior towards him. Soon, men arrive from a nearby town and demand custody of the man.
When Mark finds of the body of a murder victim, Lucas, his friend Artemus and Marshall Torrance begin a search for the killer.

A group of outlaws devise a plan to get rid of Lucas so that they can take over the town of North Fork.

Newly arrived gunslinger Al Walker throws a mammoth party at the saloon, keeping acting Marshall Ben Waller busy until Lucas is forced to intervene.
After Lucas accuses a newspaper writer's misleading articles of causing an innocent man's death, the writer begins writing articles about Lucas.
Gavin and Ezra Martin think that Lucas killed their son Clemmie while taking part in a train robbery and Lucas refuses to tell them what really happened.

Town character Brett Conway blackmails Lucas with the knowledge that a young couple Lucas rescued is suffering from yellow fever.
Lucas and Mark are stranded in the middle of a desert with very little food or water, and after Lucas is injured, Mark becomes the only hope for their survival.
While trying to protect Banker Hamilton's gold, Mark is kidnapped and held hostage at the McCain ranch and will be killed within the hour unless Lucas cooperates.

Tori has to defend herself after Jade claims Tori hurt her in a stage fighting exercise.  Meanwhile, Trina has to fend off Robbie's advances when he thinks their stage kiss meant something.
Tori accidentally gets Beck fired from a small role in a movie, then must figure out a way to get him his job back.  Meanwhile, Robbie suffers frightening nightmares about his best friend Rex.
Tori gets the lead in a high profile school musical, but freaks out when a stage makeup project goes awry, and she's left looking like a zombie on opening night.
After a jealous Jade dumps Beck, she soon regrets it and recruits Tori to help get him back.  Meanwhile, Trina puts on a one-woman show and tells Robbie he better give it a good review… or else!
Tori struggles to find the perfect birthday gift for Trina, then decides to write her sister a song as a present.  An ungrateful Trina turns the song into cash by selling it, enraging Tori.

Tori suggests Robbie capture videos of students' everyday lives to increase his blog traffic, but when the camera is turned on Tori, she asks him to stop.  Only Robbie doesn't and Tori realizes she's created a monster.

programmes.t: Victorious: A Film by Dale Squires
programmes.d: When a hot young filmmaker comes to Hollywood Arts, the kids are excited to work on his project.  But when the film is released, and they aren't given credit, the kids turn to revenge.

Sikowitz recruits the gang to form a children's band for a friend's party.  When a leaked video of the group's performance becomes popular, Andre struggles to be taken seriously as a musician.

Cat begins dating Tori's ex-boyfriend, Danny (Matt Angel) and Tori becomes jealous. Meanwhile, Trina convinces Robbie, Andre, Jade and Beck to indulge their feet in callus-eating fish that she's been buying from some stranger.
Sikowitz invites the gang to have a sleepover at his house in order to teach them a lesson in method acting.

Tori agrees to help Jade find a theater to perform a play Jade wrote. But when the sponsor demands changes that will ruin Jade's play, Tori has to make things right before opening night.

New spaces are framed and sheathed, giving us a chance to tour the new kitchen and media room.
Victory Garden chef Marian Morash and the kitchen designer refine a plan for the new kitchen.
Norm unpacks the new woodworking tools, and Steve meets with chefs to discuss the kitchen layout.
The coppersmith shows off the copper weathervane he's made for the cupola.
Steve tours Milton with realtor Susan Bolgar-Wiesjohn to see what properties are available.
A busy day at the site, as several weather-sensitive jobs are completed.
The site is thick with trucks delivering drywall, cement board, and interior wooden doors.
A new clog-free gutter system, a prefabricated wine cellar, and the central vacuum system.
A 490-pound soaking tub is hoisted through the master bath window.
The show opens with the landscaping crew putting in a granite block curb around the driveway island.
Interior designers begin their work as the construction crew scurries to finish up the job.

The grand finale in Milton, with the house completed and furnished.

In the basement, aluminum plates will help direct heat up through the old wood floor.
The lightweight concrete is mixed and poured over the kitchen's radiant floor tubing.
A break in the rainy weather means the crew can put up the new redwood siding.
Drywall has been treated with a bonding agent so that a two-coat finish plaster can be applied.
Norm trims out a window while our host checks out the last-minute work in the chapel.
Planning for a wine cellar; insulation of the third floor; repairing ceiling ornaments; fencing.

Prosecutors accusing Karen Read of murdering her boyfriend called in a neuropathologist to testify. Dr. Renee Stonebridge broke down her findings from her examination of the brain of John O'Keefe.

Jurors listened to testimony from the medical doctor who performed the autopsy on John O'Keefe. Dr. Irini Scordi-Bello found that he sustained blunt force trauma to the head and suffered from hypothermia.
The medical examiner on the stand said the manner of John O'Keefe's death was undetermined.
Jurors saw autopsy photos as part of the state's case. On the stand was the medical examiner who did the full external body examination on John O'Keefe.

The State's final witness was still under cross-examination. Dr. Irini Scordi-Bello testified that the injuries she examined on John O'Keefe's body could be consistent with both a hit-and-run and a severe beating involving blows to his head.
A snowplow driver testified that he was working in the very area where John O'Keefe was found in the snow.
Jurors were brought back for expert evaluation as to Lorena Bobbitt's state of mind when she mutilated John, her husband.

More expert testimony from a court-appointed forensic psychologist continued. Lorena Bobbitt's attorney was challenging Dr. Henry Gwaltney's report that concluded she did not suffer temporary insanity when she maimed her husband, John.
The third licensed psychologist working at the same psychiatry hospital in Virginia took the stand.

According to her mental health evaluation, Lorena Bobbitt was getting ready to leave her marriage to John. That was just days before she attacked her husband. So, why did she attack him? That'll be a question for jurors ahead in their deliberations.

The plot to take control of Southfork gets complicated. Christopher and Elena bury their feelings to work together on a business deal, but Rebecca may be hiding her own secrets.
J.R. decides to move back to Southfork, much to Ann's dismay. Bitter Ewing family enemy Cliff Barnes (KEN KERCHEVAL -- Dallas [original series]) returns.
John Ross seeks to gain an upper hand on a family member and resorts to blackmail. Christopher opens up to Bobby about his difficulty in choosing between the two women he loves.
Family ties begin to unravel when the deed to Southfork is revealed. Ann seeks help from someone in her past and Christopher decides it is time to fight dirty.
John Ross decides to move into Southfork. Rebecca approaches Bobby and Christopher with information that she believes might help save the ranch. MITCH PILEGGI guest stars.
Rebecca reveals a life-changing secret to Elena. Meanwhile, John Ross tries to turn one family member against another and a family associate is murdered.
Christopher moves closer to his dream when a large oil company approaches him about rights to new methane technology. And the Ewings fight to protect Southfork from outsiders.
John Ross learns the value of family when he must choose between blood and oil. Sue Ellen and Rebecca both find themselves victims of men who could destroy their lives.
In the dramatic season one finale, Christopher and Elena begin to learn that not everyone is as they appear to be. Long-buried secrets are revealed as the past rears its ugly head.
In the second season premiere, as Christopher seeks to gain the upper hand in his divorce from Rebecca Sutter, a game-changing revelation turns everything on its head.
Pamela Rebecca Barnes schemes with John Ross to fulfill her father's desire for revenge. Ryland's mother (JUDITH LIGHT) proves just as evil as her son.
Pamela pushes her father's agenda to gain control of Ewing Energies. As a new member of the family arrives at Southfork, Ann is pushed to the brink by Ryland's sadistic games.
J.R. works to undermine Pamela, forcing John Ross to choose between a Ewing and a Barnes. Cliff Barnes (KEN KERCHEVAL) returns to meet with an unlikely visitor.
John Ross' plot to take over Ewing Energies solidifies; Christopher changes tactics with Pamela Barnes; and an enemy from the Ewings' past resurfaces.
With Drew's help, Christopher makes a startling revelation that may change the fate of Ewing Energies. The family comes together when an outsider tries to undermine them all.
In the aftermath of John Ross and Sue Ellen's coup, Bobby's brother Gary (TED SHACKELFORD) helps him retaliate. Christopher and John Ross clash in a winner-takes-all car race.
J.R. Ewing finally meets his end. The family strives to set aside their differences and mourn together. Accompanied by many characters from J.R.'s past, the Ewings bury their own.
Bobby, Christopher and John Ross work on J.R.'s masterpiece. J.R.'s will has lasting effects on the family legacy. Sue Ellen tries to get Gary (TED SHACKELFORD) out of Dallas.
Pamela's mother, Afton Cooper (AUDREY LANDERS), returns to Dallas. Emma is put in the middle of her father and grandmother's relationship, pushing her closer to Drew.
The Ewings' investigation of a conspiracy continuing to blame Christopher for recent events brings revelations in line with J.R.'s masterpiece. A new adversary is added to the mix.
After Cliff (KEN KERCHEVAL) and Ryland put Ewing Energies on the verge of collapse, the Ewings battle back. Christopher gets closer to finding his mother.
John Ross lets Pamela in on J.R.'s master plan, but his trust may be misplaced. Drew confides a dark secret to Elena, forcing her to choose between her family and Christopher.
John Ross and Pamela make a shocking discovery about an enemy's location the night J.R. was killed, compelling Bobby to reveal more of J.R.'s master plan. LEE MAJORS guest stars.
In the electrifying second season finale, the Ewings unite to execute J.R.'s master plan and the shocking answer to the question "Who killed J.R.?" is finally revealed.
The third season begins with the Ewings on top, having vanquished Cliff Barnes (KEN KERCHEVAL). But solidarity can only last for so long, and conflicts arise.
With Nicolas' arrival, John Ross tries to keep his plans moving forward, locking horns with Bobby in the process. Emma enlists the help of her grandmother (JUDITH LIGHT).
Bobby scrambles to outmaneuver John Ross' efforts to frack on Southfork. Christopher makes a startling discovery about Nicolas' past, as Nicolas and Elena's partnership heats up.
It's wedding day at Southfork and the groom, John Ross, has skipped out to strike a deal with a family adversary. AUDREY LANDERS, STEVE KANALY and CHARLENE TILTON) guest star.
Christopher learns surprising details about Heather's (ANNALYNNE McCORD) past and Cliff (KEN KERCHEVAL) persuades Elena to try a new tact. STEVEN WEBER appears as the Governor.
John Ross scrambles to keep the Arctic lease deal alive, even if he must betray those who love him most. Ryland's plot to keep Emma and John Ross apart takes an unexpected turn.
John Ross pushes ahead on his plans for control of Ewing Global, enlisting the help of one of J.R.'s last business partners. Elena's brother, Drew (KUNO BECKER), returns to Dallas.
Pamela's discovery that John Ross has been sleeping with Emma ignites a firestorm. As cliffhangers build, lives and relationships are brought to the brink.
The Ewing family searches for answers as to who set the fire at Southfork Ranch and who will survive. John Ross and Emma struggle with their role in Pamela's overdose.
Christopher and Heather's (ANNALYNNE McCORD) relationship is tested as John Ross tries to redeem himself with Pamela. Elena makes a drastic move to get justice for her family.
Elena finally confronts the Ewings. The family is shocked, realigning relationships and forcing Bobby to re-examine the steps he took to implement J.R.'s master plan.
As Ewing Global goes public, everyone scrambles to claim ownership. Bobby seeks the aide of old flame (MELINDA CLARKE) to help get back control of the company.
Elena learns the truth about Nicolass connections to the cartel, which sends her spiraling and Christopher fears for her safety. Bobby must make a choice he never anticipated.
Nicolas tries to prove himself to Elena by making a deal with the authorities that puts him on a collision course with John Ross' plan and places both their lives in jeopardy.
In the season finale, enemies are unmasked, new alliances are formed and John Ross learns a shocking secret about J.R. that sends him in search of a surprising new cohort.
In the series premiere, NYPD Detective Raimy Sullivan (PEYTON LIST) discovers she's able to speak with her deceased father, Frank (RILEY SMITH) over his old ham radio.
When Raimy warns Frank that her mom will be murdered unless he can somehow warn her, she also delivers some devastating news about Stan Moreno (ANTHONY RUIVIVAR).
After Raimy uncovers evidence in the Goff case, she relays this information to Frank, prompting him to take matters into his own hands while ignoring a strong warning from Satch.
With the date of Julie's abduction rapidly approaching, Raimy and Frank each work to gather information from a girl whose mother was taken by the Nightingale.
When Frank helps Raimy uncover clues from the past to help solve a present day murder case, it brings up two different memories of her first day in the NYPD.
In 2016, Raimy meets a strange character named Karl (CURTIS ARMSTRONG), who speaks to himself in the future. In 1996, Frank feels like he's being taunted by The Nightingale.
Raimy and Satch's detective work begins to pay off when a cold case victim leads them to their biggest break -- a room where the Nightingale held his first victim.
While Raimy and Satch discover a shocking connection to the Nightingale's first kill, Frank and Julie are forced to have an honest conversation. And Raimy has a surprise visitor.

On October 2, 1987, a Boston police officer responding to a domestic disturbance call was fatally wounded.  Local authorities launched a citywide manhunt, but were only able to find the fingerprints of the chief suspect.  Believing that he had fled the area, the FBI followed the suspect's trail to the west coast and then across the Mexican border, always aware of the desperation of a cop killer and of the need for justice.

In 1994, a rash of home invasion robberies take place in the metropolitan Detroit area.  The thieves turn out to be part of a local gang dubbed the Home Invaders.  Their crimes extend to insurance fraud, theft, and illegal lottery schemes.  The Violent Crimes Task Force (VCTF) opens an investigation, and with the cooperation of a gang member who was apprehended at the scene of a crime, they are able to obtain the names, addresses, and telephone numbers of 16 gang members.

Beginning in California in 1995, a serial killer targeted vulnerable women. At first charming and generous, he quickly became violent. He was brutal with his kills and quick in his getaways. Traveling across the country, he struck in Mississippi, Louisiana and Florida. The FBI and local police needed to stop this cross-country killer before more women fell victim to his insatiable rage.

In the late 1970s, the FBI had a working knowledge of anti-Castro terrorists operating in the United States.  But then a new group appeared, more violent and aggressive than their predecessors.  All agents had to go on was a series of chilling phone calls, a mysterious voice, and the threat of more violence.  FBI field offices from New York to Miami coordinated their efforts, determined to catch the vicious killers.

In the late 70s and early 80s, a terrorist group known as the FALN is suspected of setting off bombs in major U.S. cities. Their goal - to bring attention to the Puerto Rican independence movement.  As the bombings escalate, innocent lives are lost. FBI agents and police are is in a deadly race to stop this murderous group with a dangerous cause.

In Philadelphia, a ruthless grab for power leads to a full-scale mob war.  The local Mafia crime family splits in two as the young and the old fight to the death.  The FBI is caught in the middle as they infiltrate the syndicate through informants and high-tech surveillance.  Agents must find a way to bring down the organization before their civil war leads to innocent causalities.

In the late 1980s, the FBI matches wits with a cunning bank robber -- a lone gunman responsible for the longest string of unsolved bank robberies in FBI history.  The robber's planning is meticulous.  He executes his crimes with military precision.  It will take the combined skills of local police and dozens of agents  to catch a criminal mastermind they call, "The Shootist."

In Puerto Rico, violent militants are intent on turning the US Commonwealth into a communist dictatorship.  They murder a policeman, turns their guns on a busload of unarmed Navy workers, and even launch an attack on the FBI.  These ruthless killers have vowed to fight to the death.  The FBI must use every tactic at their disposal to track down the terrorists and bring them to justice.

In Washington D.C, a car bomb takes the life of a former ambassador and his secretary.  The FBI is on the case and begins sifting through layers of a wide-ranging conspiracy.  The scope of the investigation broadens when it becomes apparent that a foreign government, ruled by a ruthless dictator, ordered the attack.   Agents and prosecutors must engage in a political tug-of-war to uncover the identities of the assassins.

In Boston, FBI agents and local police tracked a gang of robbers who specialized in armored car takedowns.  Their MO was familiar -- the gang used precise timing to steal millions in cash and burned their getaway cars to destroy evidence.  As the robberies grew more violent, agents launched a complex sting: To trap a deadly ring of thieves and shut down their dangerous operation.

Two couples found themselves on the same deserted island paradise.  But only one couple left alive. Buck Walker and Stephanie Stearns arrived in Hawaii on the Sea Wind, which belonged to the missing couple, Mac and Muff Graham.  Buck and Stephanie were arrested and served time for boat theft.  But years later, bones were discovered on the deserted island and identified as the remains of Muff Graham.

A stranger snatched an eight-year-old girl as she played in her Tucson, Arizona neighborhood, leaving behind an abandoned bicycle and a frantic mother.  Hundreds of citizens and police officers fanned out across the region, hoping to find some trace of the young girl or her abductor.  Within hours, a suspect emerged; a drifter who was out on parole for abducting and molesting children.  He was nowhere to be found and time had run out for the innocent child.

In Anchorage, Alaska, a young mother and her two daughters were sexually assaulted and brutally murdered.  There was only one piece of forensic evidence: a washrag carrying pubic lice that the killer used to clean himself after the crime.  Employing an unusual and original method, an FBI expert combed through all the hairs and fibers in the apartment.  He was not only able to determine how long each hair had been there, but which hairs came from the killer and how the crime proceeded.

He was a recluse who spread terror through the mail for 18 years. Two men died and more than a dozen were injured, but Ted Kaczynski wasn't known as the Unabomber until his brother tipped off the FBI. Kaczynski's “Unabomber Manifesto,” published in major newspapers, set off a flurry of activity for the FBI: writing analysis and comparisons, DNA gleaned from a single postage stamp and finally, Kaczynski's arrest at his tiny cabin.

In August 1992, a man returned to his Memphis home and discovered that his wife was missing.  The husband, as well as his friends, family and neighbors began to receive ransom calls.  FBI agents noticed that one neighbor seemed to have the best rapport with the kidnapper.  They began to question his level of involvement, but had to proceed carefully, knowing that he could be their only link to the missing woman.

In 1980, extortionists plant a thousand pound bomb in a Nevada casino and demand millions of dollars, or they will detonate the device. The bomb is the largest explosive device the FBI has ever seen. Detonation would be a disaster. Agents and bomb experts must disarm the deadly device, and stop the dangerous extortionist who built it.

In New York, the FBI and local police join forces to battle the constant influx of Colombian cocaine into the city's ports.  One detective goes undercover, posing as a Mafia wise-guy, and infiltrates a drug gang connected to Pablo Escobar's Medellin cartel.  The detective must be bold, but cautious, taking on the role of a tough-guy, but always aware that if the gang suspects anything, they won't hesitate to kill him.

In the 1980's the New York City Police Department is fighting a losing battle in the war on drugs. Distributors and drug gangs in New York are making millions, and they will do anything to protect their profits. After two law enforcement officers are targeted,  hundreds of police officers and FBI agents devise a bold plan to crackdown on the drug gangs and shut down their deadly business.

In Puerto Rico, the death of a government witness, and the suspicious circumstances surrounding it, lead the FBI and local authorities to suspect corruption in the highest levels of the police force. With the help of a cooperating witness, investigators find the scope of the corruption is far greater that they first thought. Authorities struggle to capture the rouge officers, men who once swore to uphold the law, but now use their power to commit heinous crimes.

After a scandalous piece of good fortune, Rimmer is promoted to being an Officer.
Kryten has a mid-life crisis and changes his body cover from grey to Ferrari red.
Cat takes time off from being in love with himself to fall for a lady Cat.
The crew stumble on a science centre where vile historical figures have been 'cured' of evil.
Lister, Cat and Rimmer are uploaded into mechanoid bodies and forced into slavery.
The Dwarfers run into a ship where criticism is illegal.
When the machines on Red Dwarf go on strike, a presidential election is held.
The Dwarfers discover that the owners of Red Dwarf have been bought out.
Rimmer looks for another dimension where he is not such a giant loser.
A radiation leak wipes out the crew of the ship Red Dwarf, leaving only one survivor.
Lister is presented with a disappointing vision of his future, but Rimmer is delighted.
Rimmer encounters his most dangerous challenge ever - Lister is taking the chef's exam.
Lister's rather mundane day perks up a little when he discovers he is a God.
Lister contracts a mutated virus and his hallucinations materialise in solid form.
Rimmer creates his perfect companion - an identical duplicate of himself.
The crew answer a cry for help from three damsels and an android in distress.
The boys become immersed in the Better than Life reality game.
Lister and Cat wake up with their legs in plaster. What's going on?
The crew of Red Dwarf have found a way to go back in time three million years.
Holly has been deposed and the back-up computer Queeg 500 is in control of Red Dwarf.
Holly's latest invention takes the crew into a bizarre parallel universe.
Time starts to run backwards after the boys travel through a time hole.
Red Dwarf is on a collision course towards a minefield of black holes.
A chameleonic genetic mutant which sucks out human emotions is loose aboard Red Dwarf.
Lister accidentally triggers the ship's self-destruct system.
The crew run amok through history, blithely ignoring the consequences of causality.
Kryten has 24 hours to live, so the crew decide to give him the best night of his life.
Kryten falls in love with a female droid rescued from a crashed vessel.
Lister's curry finds its way into the transmogrifier and assumes near-human form.
Justice World is able to inflict crime back on the perpetrator. Rimmer is in big trouble.
Holly, for reasons best known to herself, decides to power down the ship.
In a universe almost identical to our own, another more heroic Arnold Rimmer exists.
A matter transporter whisks the crew to Waxworld - a giant theme park.
Rimmer is transmitted from Red Dwarf to the advanced Holoship, Enlightenment.
The Inquisitor roams through time weeding out life's wastrels and deleting the worthless.
Rimmer is taken prisoner inside his own mind and ends up being stripped and humiliated.
After an encounter at a viral research centre, Rimmer puts the crew in quarantine.
The boys from the Dwarf meet their evil doppelgangers, hell bent on destruction.
The crew discover an abandoned space ship, complete with a gigantic sea monster.
In pursuit of the stolen Red Dwarf, Lister and Co are attacked by scantily-clad Psirens.
A malfunctioning guidance beam drags the Dwarfers to a deserted space station.
Kryten contracts a deadly computer virus, and the crew are forced to enter his mindscape.
Lister gets a horrifying proposal from the chief of the offensively ugly GELF tribe.
Trapped aboard a disintegrating ship, Rimmer abandons his crewmates.
The crew are alarmed to receive an SOS call from themselves fifteen years into the future.
Lister's search for an Indian takeaway brings him to Dallas, 1963.
Rimmer's alter ego, Ace, arrives on Starbug fatally wounded with one dying request.
The Dwarfers encounter a real, live human woman who's attractive and nice.
The crew go on a journey of personal discovery when their generators fail.
Lister is missing Rimmer, at least until Kryten steps in to help.
In a hope to educate the crew Kochansky transports them to Pride and Prejudice World.
Lister is impregnated with a virus and he tries to talk his way out of the problem.
The crew finally discover who stole Red Dwarf and why.
The nanobots have not only re-created Red Dwarf, they have also brought back the old crew.
Rimmer plans to move up the career ladder with help from a 'sexual magnetism virus'.
The Dwarfers face two years in the brig for crimes against the Space Corps.
Lister joins a battle-hardened convict army, trained to go on suicide missions.
Kryten, who has been reprogrammed, starts his own pay TV station for the prisoners.
Lister and Rimmer are forced to take on the guards in a basketball game.
Pete the Sparrow is devolved into a Tyrannosaurus Rex by a time-wand.
The Dwarfers are now on probation and are trying their hardest to behave.
Nine years on and the Red Dwarf crew are older but still none the wiser.
Rimmer's replacement, Katerina, is determined to guide Lister back to his home planet.
Knowing they are destined to die, the Dwarfers head to a mysterious address to plead for life.
Rimmer receives an SOS Distress Call from his all-conquering brother, Howard.
On Father's Day, Rimmer points out Lister has been a lousy father to himself.
Marooned in Britain in 23 AD, the Dwarfers need an 8 volt battery to get home.

Soon the team is forced into a beyblade match to rescue Kenny from the monsters' evil clutches! But Kenny isn't the only prize in this dark match-up. For if the Bladebreakers lose, their bit-beasts are up for grabs'

Tyson comes up with the idea of using the Eiffel Tower as a vantage point to speed up their search. But Tyson soon proves that even the French Champion has a thing or two to learn about Beyblading.

This time, Tyson pits the two heads of Enrique's Bit Beast Amphilyon against each other, and saves Enrique's life when Amphilyon turns on him.

Enrique and Oliver decide to take our heroes on a dirigible ride to visit Robert's castle. Tyson's patience, however, is tested when they have to sit and wait for their host who is 'not to be disturbed.' Ray and Oliver battle fiercely and the first round ends in a tie. Johnny and Kai, bitter rivals, step to the bowl. But can Kai defeat the man who defeated him?

Match two gets underway at the Olympia Coliseum, and with a little unsolicited help by his teammates, Kai walks away with a win. The match is tied and the Majestics grudgingly admit to themselves that the only way they'll win the contest is to fight as a team, as the Bladebreakers do. Facing off against Tyson in the final match, will Robert be able to apply the fundamentals of teamwork? And will the Bladebreakers ever discover who sent them on their cross-Europe trip in the first place'?

With the charm of an old world count, Boris invites them to lunch and them brings them to the training facility where they meet the next generation of Beybladers. Meanwhile, Kai returns to the Abbey to find out why it fills him with foreboding. The Bladebreakers track down their missing teammate to the Abbey, but are denied access by two of its wunderkind bladers. Summoned by Kai to Beyblade on a frozen lake, the Bladebreakers must not only win to save their Bit Beasts, but must convince Kai that they will always be his teammates. Can they do it'?

Now that Kai is finally loyal to the 'Bladebreakers,' he returns the Black Dranzer to Boris, doing severe damage to the enemy headquarters in the process. At first it seems strange that Robert would do this, but Tyson accepts and a battle ensues with Tyson losing two straight. He becomes infuriated! Mysterious VHS tapes with horrific contents are found in a missing student's abandoned house.

programmes.d: Eva is mother to the evil Kevin. She contends with her clueless husband and her son's malevolent ways, in this chilling and unforgettable film.

A young Tennessee woman mysteriously vanishes and misses her family's Thanksgiving dinner; determined to track her down, her family takes matters into their own hands, pursuing every digital clue she left behind.
Police suspect a serial killer when two women and their teenage daughters are murdered in Maryland; during the search for clues, it's revealed that a master thief is the key to solving the mystery.
When a young woman finds out that her boyfriend might have shot and killed a college football player out of revenge, she struggles with coming forward to officials, fearing she could lose her life.
The residents of a glamorous resort town are shocked when a well-known woman from a prominent family is found dead in her home.

Friends of accused murderer Robert Durst talk about his recent arrest in New Orleans and his whereabouts over the past 30 years.

When a young, handsome veterinarian is found dead in his home in Montana, the mystery remains unsolved for nearly two decades.

A similar abduction in New Mexico helps crack the case of a 19-year-old missing college student in Oregon.

Stark plans to rob a less-than-reputable bank to get them money for a sizable purchase of slaves, but things don't quite go the way he thinks they will.
Infected currency from the Shadow Depository threatens the crew of the Moya as they decide how best to rescue D'Argo's son.
The crew of the injured Moya must rely on the help of disorganized mercenaries to save Crichton from Scorpius.
An alien surgeon comes to the aid of Crichton, removing the control chip from his head and healing the Moya.
The Moya's crew must quickly recover from their last adventure because Scorpius is up to his old tricks.
An outrageous love triangle ignites dangerous sparks aboard a space station, where the crew find themselves trapped during a powerful interstellar storm.
Crichton learns the elusive technology that could allow him to return home to Earth, but while he is preoccupied with the consequences a crew member unsuspectingly nears death.
A crew member must volunteer to stay behind to guide the sabotaged ship, knowing that it will soon be atomized.
Indulging in some high-tech sightseeing at the site of a major historical event, Crichton and his friends are sucked through a time rift and find themselves in the middle of a key battle.
A brain-sucking alien and a pack of crazed Xarai threaten D'Argo, Chiana and Jool.
Traveling to a warring planet to obtain medicine for Talyn, who was injured in a skirmish with a Peacekeeper Retrieval Squad.

Talyn gets swallowed by a Budong, and it is up to Stark to save them; Crichton, already distrustful of Crais, believes he and Aeryn are having an affair while Talyn himself soon shows his hatred of the human.
Parasitic Energy Riders hitch a ride on Moya, planning to plant themselves inside the bodies of the crew.
The Peacekeeper Retrieval Squad finally reveals its true mission when it confronts Crichton and his crew.
Scorpius (Wayne Pygram) risks it all when appealing to Crichton (Ben Browder) for an alliance by revealing his shrouded past.
Crichton's ship suddenly begins flying toward the sun and he, along with crewmates Aeryn and Crais, battles to override its compulsion.
Crichton and his crew take a cruise on a "pleasure planet," but it turns out to be more of a pain than they bargained for.
A dangerous species unlocks the long-held secrets to wormhole technology, unleashing the fury of the Ancients.
Crichton and Aeryn race to construct the ultimate weapon in order to survive an attack by the Scarrans.
A strange ship bent on self-destruction targets Moya and with Crichton in a coma, D'Argo has to save the day.
Aeryn yearns to contact her father when the crew lands on a planet laden with mystics, seers and also frauds.
The crew encounters a group of escaped Peacekeeper prisoners including a Nebari, a Scarran and a female Hynerian.
A dangerous situation forces the crew to make a tough decision.
Crichton, Aeryn and Crais are welcomed aboard Scorpius' carrier; Scorpius promises amnesty in exchange for wormhole technology; Scorpius threatens to destroy something close to Crichton's heart.
An unlikely source betrays the crew while trying to stop Scorpius' master plan.
The crew must overcome a difficult challenge or face being torn apart; Crichton is haunted by visions of love and death.
Danish Crichton tries to survive aboard the Elack; a female alien and mercenaries are keen to harvest Elack's neural tissue.
Crichton falls under the control of the mysterious and dangerous allure and control of Commandant Grayza.
D'Argo and Sikozu develop a plan to run into the Peacekeepers' ship with Elack, but success requires Crichton getting closer to Grayza.
The crew faces a lava-filled cave and a mercenary squad after an emergency landing.
The crew reunites at Moya, where Crichton discovers that Aeryn is suffering from heatstroke and is being cared for by Scorpius, who is seeking asylum at Moya.
Crichton correctly predicts a wormhole's appearance near Moya, but simultaneously a giant space plant captures the Leviathan.
Crichton and Chiana get stuck in a video game where they encounter strange and twisted versions of their friends.
When a gang of bounty hunters overtakes Moya, Crichton must team with a dubious ally.
Chiana and Crichton are sucked into a game world ruled by a virtual stark; to escape, they must fight against friends and enemies in disguises.
An alien doctor poisons the Moya's crew with deadly mollusks.
An interdimensional being believes that Crichton's wormhole knowledge threatens the universe.
After accidentally returning to Earth, Crichton discovers he is in 1985, and he has altered the timeline, causing his father to be scheduled to fly on the doomed shuttle Challenger.
The aliens meet an amazed and apprehensive public; Crichton tries to readjust to life on Earth.
Chiana purchases an abused slave girl from a passing trading ship.
Scorpius takes Crichton, D'Argo and Rygel to an advanced training camp where students learn mental discipline.
The women of Moya stumble upon a secret meeting that will change the future of the Uncharted Territories.
The crew travels through a wormhole to Earth in 1985; when Crichton discovers that his father is about to fly the doomed ride with the Challenger, he tries to turn back time.
Crichton and Scorpius travel through a wormhole to a mixed-up version of Moya in search of abducted Aeryn.
Moya's crew traces Aeryn to a freighter at a scarecrow border station; Noranti releases a deadly, contagious virus to keep the vessel in dock.
