It is February at River Cottage, and there is precious little to eat in the pantry. But that does not stop Hugh from building "Chickenopolis." Hugh also navigates the River Brit to the sea, and receives surprising news about his sheep.

Eager to secure fishing rights to the cottage's lake, Hugh makes a wager with his landlord Antony Hichens: If Hugh can prepare a meal of carp that satisfies Antony and his guests, then Hugh shall have fishing rights to the property's lake.

It is late May, and there is bad news all around regarding the livestock, but Hugh's spirits are raised when news of cuttlefish hit his ears. At the Shaftesbury Market, Hugh ends up in a bidding war for a calf and ends up paying too much.

Hugh is determined to successfully harvest his own hay this season. He also clears his polytunnel of peas and beans in preparation for the Bridport Farmers' Market, and receives local assistance to turn his wool into fashionable garments.

Hugh summons experts to help deal with his uncooperative livestock, and soon, he feels confident in entering his saddleback, Delia, into the Okehampton Agricultural Show. Hugh also grapples with a serious aphid problem in the polytunnel.
River Cottage offers a new dining experience this season, Leftovers Night.

Hugh enters his healthy vegetables into the Vegetable Challenge Cup, but first, to make some cash, he makes a batch of ice-lollies to sell to people on holiday in Dorset, and also takes Delia truffle hunting with a local mycologist.

One of Hugh's ewes has died, and two of his pigs have a date with the abattoir. However, despite all this, Hugh decides to plant roots at River Cottage, and is inspired to plant an orchard. His chickens are also nice and healthy.

As winter nears, Hugh would like to make some money at the Borough Farmers' Market, where he and Michael wind up making a small fortune. Then, after a day of bass fishing, Hugh attends a Halloween Party and partakes in Pumpkin Fettling.

Hugh's new farm is 10 times the size of River Cottage, so he plans to expand production, including setting up a culinary headquarters where he can sell direct to the public, but he soon wonders if he has bitten off more than he can chew.

Several weeks after Hugh leased a collection of barns near his farm to serve as his culinary headquarters, he gives himself a two-week deadline to accomplish the task of getting the muck-ridden buildings up and running by Valentine's Day.

Hugh builds a maternity room for his sow that is moments away from giving birth. He also contemplates how to install plumbing in his new headquarters, and he challenges himself to put the neglected purple broccoli back on the culinary map.
This year’s abundance is enough to tempt the most committed of carnivores.

On May Day, Hugh takes advantage of a healthy crowd that gathers on the Cerne Abbas Giant by selling his famous chocolate waffles. It is also opening night at The River Cottage HQ, and Hugh hopes to serve his guests something spectacular.

There are new arrivals on Hugh's farm this spring, including 11 piglets and two baby lambs. Hugh also attends an Easter Blossom Picnic Party, goes mushroom hunting for morells, and gets a crash course in breadmaking from a master baker.

Hugh installs beehives at The River Cottage HQ, the only problem is his fear of being stung. He also takes on his biggest event yet, a wedding party, and the newlyweds want their entire menu to only include wild, or home-grown, cuisine.

It is party season in Dorset, and Hugh teams up with a local fisherman to catch whelks before spicing them up to sell on the beaches on Carnival Day. Back at The River Cottage HQ, Hugh is inspired to create the West Dorset Tomato Festival.

The day has arrived for Hugh to harvest his honey, and with some help from Ken Bishop, they carefully extract a robust 25 lbs. worth of the golden sweetness. Hugh then enters some culinary delights into the Melplash Agricultural Show.

Hugh plans a sumptuous menu for a special Autumn feast he plans to throw at The River Cottage HQ that includes a chicken feast, courtesy of Chickenopolis. It is also a good time of year to go mushroom hunting, but this time, from the air.

Hugh arrives at River Cottage to begin his dream life away from the city sprawl and immediately sets to work preparing the land for his new vegetable garden and finding livestock. Hugh also attempts spearfishing and meets his new landlord.

The pigs have settled in nicely to their new home, and Hugh believes it is now a good time to introduce chickens to the farm. Hugh also finds a pesky garden pest to contend with, learns the finer points of fishing, and visits a fruit farm.
River Cottage offers a new dining experience this season, Leftovers Night.

It is summer at River Cottage and the vegetables are thriving, so much so that Hugh decides to enter The Beaminster Horticultural Society's annual competition, with the Tomatillo as his secret ingredient. Hugh also fishes for spider crabs.

Hugh discovers that mice are a formidable pest to contend with. Spurred on by this experience, he joins Jan Andrews on a hunt for deer. Hugh then strolls down memory lane with the Cheeseman family and creates a Japanese prawn tempura dish.

It is eel migration season, and Hugh learns how to weave a unique basket trap to catch them in the river. He also joins the Chideock Cider Circle for the fall apple harvest, learns the art of cider pressing, and attends a pheasant hunt.

Hugh has lived in River Cottage for six months, and that means his pigs have a date with butcher Ray Smith. It also means it is time for a party. Hugh also learns a remarkable technique for catching razor clams down by the seashore.

Now that he has some extra land to work with, Hugh purchases some livestock, prompting he and Angus Carmichael, a local carpenter, to build a fox-proof chicken coop. Hugh also goes scallop hunting, and enters a nettle eating competition.

Hugh's cattle and sheep are settling in, but a few of the chickens are not. Also, local vet Jeff Thomson helps with the delicate operation of castrating the calf, Hugh builds a polytunnel, and rabbits wreak havoc on the vegetables.

It is time for Hugh's landlord, Antony Hichens, to host his annual medieval fair, and Hugh decides to donate a pig for the feast. He also helps local bakers create a batch of traditional Dorset lardy cakes and learns hot to shear sheep.

Torrential late summer rains spell doom for Hugh's hay harvest, and only radical plant-surgery can save his tomatoes from blight, however the weather has helped mushrooms flourish. Hugh also enters a sheep in the Melpash Agricultural Show.

Hugh embarks to sell his entire tomato harvest at the Farmer's Market by offering a diverse range of products under the brand name: The River Cottage Glutton. Hugh also makes a bet with a rival grower as to who will sell more at market.
This year’s abundance is enough to tempt the most committed of carnivores.

With a failed hay harvest, Hugh conceives a cunning plan to supplement the winter feed he will need for his animals by throwing a party, but instead of a bottle he asks his guests to bring a bale. Hugh also agrees to an unusual request.

When a charmingly sweet doe wanders onto the Douglas farm, an enchanted Lisa befriends the beautiful animal. Having had her heart won over, Lisa resolves to have all deer hunting banned in Hooterville, winning support however necessary.

Farmhand Eb plans to take his girlfriend to a fancy restaurant for her birthday. Only problem is he can't afford it. Oliver encourages Eb to get creative and figure out how to earn the money himself. And if Eb is anything, it's creative.

Lisa becomes enchanted with the diary of a Lydia Plunkett. Found in an old trunk in the barn, the diary from 1898 tells Lydia's life story as a successful businesswoman. Eb and Lisa are glued to every page of the story, but Oliver isn't impressed.

Mr. Haney and Fred Ziffel try to persuade Oliver to invest in a new business venture. "Looney Luke" Needlinger claim to have invented a machine that can turn hay into fresh milk. Oliver is skeptical and tries to prove the machine is a white lie.

Lisa's "Mudder" pays a surprise visit to Lisa and Oliver. Eb good-naturedly introduces her as the Queen of Sicily. As a result, the entire town treats her like royalty. They even go so far as to hold a special day in her honor.

Arnold Ziffel, Hooterville's beloved swine is thought to have rightful claim to a $20,000 fortune. The Birnbacher pork empire has promised that the descendant of the famous weather-predicting pig, Herman, will inherit the vast sum.

Oliver, Lisa and Eb travel to Chicago with Arnold to prove the pig is the rightful heir to the Birnbacher pork empire. Will this pig get rich? Arnold makes a surprising prediction that baffles all, including all the lawyers involved.

When Oliver returns home with Arnold, the citizens in town hold a large reception for Arnold. But when Oliver receives a phone call from a lawyer representing an eccentric relative of the Birnbachers, the riches go into question.

Oliver is mad over the town's dirt road, especially when he finds out that the state set aside money over thirty years ago to fix it. Oliver goes to the Capitol to get the road paved but hits a roadblock when the Ziffels' house must be torn down.

Lisa foretells of a mysterious stranger that will appear into Oliver's life. Enter Tadpole Talbot, Eb's childhood friend who has become a singing sensation. Tadpole has convinced Eb to go out on the road with him and join his band as a roadie.

Oliver become alarmed that the youth of his beloved town, Hooterville is dwindling so he calls an emergency town meeting to prevent them from leaving. The next thing Oliver knows is that his barn has been volunteered for the new youth center.

Oliver is asked to speak at the local high school about his illustrious law career and makes quite an impression on student Kathy Baxter. Oliver must contend with Kathy's fawning as well as her jealous boyfriend is not very happy with Oliver.

Hank Kimball proposes marriage to lady carpenter Ralph Monroe while under the influence of heavy medication. Lisa plans an amazing country wedding only to find out that, Sam, the Justice of the Peace, has forgotten to new his license.

Oliver plants his crops, worrying that they haven't been planted in time for a harvest. Lisa tries to be helpful and mixes up a batch of sour lemonade. Oliver pours out the bitter elixir in the newly planted field, with an unimaginable consequence.

Sam Drucker does not stock any cosmetics in his store, much to the chagrin of Lisa. Lisa decides to set up a "small" display in the store. When the merchandise is delivered, it forces Mr. Drucker to retreat to the front porch.

Mr. Haney discovers an old wish book dating back to 1898 that tells the story of Calvin and Tessie Whittaker who once owned the Douglases' farm and how Calvin traveled to Hollywood to pitch his idea of putting a mouse named Dickey into films.

Oliver and Lisa discover a root cellar under their house and become trapped when it collapses in on them. Their only hope to get rescued rides on a hilarious game of charades between Arnold the pig and Mr. Drucker.

Oliver goes to New York to finish up a case at his old firm. Meanwhile back on the farm, Lisa and Eb find a puppy left on the doorstep. Lisa, in all her innocence, leads Oliver to believe the puppy, affectionally named Freddie, is a human baby.

Oliver has been invited to give a speech at the Bar Association. He is there to advocate for the hiring of ex-convicts. He eventually ends up regretting his speech when he is forced to hire an ex-convict by the name of Willie Dunhill.

Oliver's crops are getting stomped on by Irene the cow. In his frustration, he fires a shotgun to scare Irene away. Instead the blast leads to a hilarious misunderstanding among Lisa, Eb and a life-sized fiberglass cow.

Oliver has become the new School Board President. Unfortunately, Oliver's first day on the job is anything but smooth. Arnold the pig is expelled from his duties as the school's mascot, and Fred Ziffel implores Oliver to defend Arnold.

After receiving a tax refund from the IRS, Oliver inspires his fellow citizens to make similar requests. There's only one problem... those making requests haven't paid their taxes! Nevertheless, the IRS mistakenly sends out half a million dollars!

Oliver is insistent that he and Lisa have a romantic Sunday afternoon picnic, all alone. His romantic gesture for two turns into a picnic for the entire town. Finally, Oliver finds them a romantic refuge in a most unlikely place.

Local boy Dinky Watson has one heck of a story to tell anyone who will listen. When Dinky convinces Lisa to buy a "moon rock" for the considerable sum of $14, Oliver suspects that she is the victim of a practical joke.

When Lisa's Uncle Fedor comes to visit her at the farm, he is visibly upset. He claims that someone is following him. Indeed, Fedor is convinced that the Secret Police are out to steal back a valuable scientific formula, which only he knows.

When Eb places an ad in a magazine claiming to be a wealthy landowner, it catches the eye of a young socialite. When the young woman makes an unexpected visit to Hooterville, Eb is forced to keep up his ruse.

Oliver is upset when he finds out Arnold the pig and he share the same birthday. Jealous that Arnold is getting more attention than he is, Oliver becomes convinced that Lisa is throwing him a surprise party and drives all over town in search for it.

Oliver and Lisa play host to four children from the city, who find themselves in Hooterville as part of a rural exposure program. The kids learn how to milk the cow, pick vegetables, plant seeds, and share sleeping quarters with four-legged friends.

Little Lori Baker, who after coming to stay with the Douglases on a rural experience program, is staying on at the Douglas farm. This city girl, like Oliver, has found that she loves the country life! Lisa decides to throw Lori a welcome party.

Lisa tells a rather fanciful version of how she met and fell in love with Oliver. The Douglases' house guest, little Lori Baker from the city, is all ears. The tale begins with how Lisa's father, the king, was exiled, causing Lisa to flee to Paris.

The residents of Hooterville assume that Oliver Douglas must be broke when Lisa is spotted looking for work and standing in line at the soup kitchen. But assumptions in this town, even logical ones, are bound to be wrong.

There is the old adage that warns never to discuss politics with your spouse... but what if you are both running for the same office?! That predicament comes true when Oliver and Lisa face each other in the Hooterville mayoral election.

Lisa and Oliver try to sort out of the troubles of fools in love. The problems begin when Eb invites both his girlfriend and another young woman to the same dance, while Arnold the pig falls for not one, but two attractive bovines.

Oliver is having a tough time. He has no one to help him pick the apples from his orchard, and he's promised to teach Lisa how to drive. The neighbors are all injured from assisting other harvests, and Lisa has a run-in with a sheriff.

Eb feels the time is right to settle down and marry Darlene. However, he has nowhere near the money it will take to make a down payment on a house. With the help of the Douglases, who have given him two acres of land, Eb applies for a loan.

Eb believes he has found his destiny when an accounting course he has enrolled in turns out to be acting workshop. All the world's a stage. Ed dives into acting and turns every simple interaction at the Douglas farm into a starring role.

After Lisa attends a Women's Liberation League meeting, she gives Oliver a scolding for denying her equal rights and demands to swap chores. While Lisa does a stellar job at Oliver's work, Oliver's attempts at hers leave something to be desired.

The construction of the Great Western Railroad causes tension between settlers and Native American tribes. Criminal gang leader Santer seeks control of a gold mine on sacred Apache land and manipulates the railroad route through it. Old Shatterhand, working as a surveyor, uncovers the scheme and tries to warn the Apaches to prevent war.

Falsely convicted for robbing an army treasury, Tony Garrett escapes prison and sets out to find the real criminals responsible. As he hunts for revenge, he faces dangers and uncovers dark truths, determined to clear his name and make the true culprits pay for their actions.

When Django’s fiancée is kidnapped by the ruthless Cortez brothers after a bank robbery, he joins forces with an American ally and agent Fulton, who’s tasked with recovering the stolen gold. Together, they face the gang hiding in a remote cave for a perilous rescue and revenge mission.
Spaghetti Western icon Anthony Steffen stars as Shenandoah, a mysterious man who joins a ruthless band of highwaymen after overcoming an almost impossible and death-defying initiation.

programmes.t: There's a Noose Waiting for You Trinity!
programmes.d: Trinity is an ex-gunslinger desperately wanting to be forgiven and accepted by his family that he abandoned years earlier. Unfortunately for him, a ruthless bounty hunter is on his trail.

A young half-breed is saved from death and raised as a son by his rescuer. Years later, love and betrayal tear the family apart when he falls for his adoptive sister, while a vengeful woman plots the downfall of the man who once saved them both.

programmes.t: Raise Your Hands, Dead Man, You're Under Arrest
programmes.d: The sole survivor, named Sando Kid (Peter Lee Lawrence), of a massacre in the North seeks revenge. After suffering the atrocity, the Kid executes a solo revenge, razes, beats and kills everyone involved in the massacre.

Clint Harrison is a gunslinger who has been running from vengeful foes for years. He returns to the town he once abandoned and discovers his family has moved away to escape his bad reputation. Seeking redemption, he tracks them down and becomes caught in a violent conflict between farmers and a ruthless rancher willing to kill for land.
A man is falsely charged with bank robbery, prompting his brother to break him out of prison.
Two outlaws, "The Doctor" and the Indian Girolamo, help a village fight a gang and a corrupt sheriff who has discovered gold beneath the town.

Brandon returns and makes a shocking confession. Deb and Brat explode after giving ReeMarkable one last chance. All hell breaks loose when Corri shows up on a rampage against Bow. Tammy's big NYC show goes off the rails.

Ksenia le exige a Piotr que se aleje de Rita, pero él no piensa repetir el error de dejar ir a su gran amor: está decidido a luchar por ella. Rita responde igual de firme: no renunciará a Piotr por sus padres. Mientras crece el escándalo de las casas estatales, Edik, colega de Piotr, descubre que intervienen su teléfono, vinculado a la élite política. La amenaza se vuelve real cuando dos desconocidos irrumpen en la redacción exigiendo el expediente, o la familia de Piotr pagará el precio.

Por seguridad, Pyotr decide que Rita debe quedarse con sus padres, y logra una tregua temporal con Ksenia. Pero cuando entrega su artículo para la próxima edición, órdenes "desde arriba" retiran toda la tirada acusándolo de difamación. Dmitri, sin renunciar a separar a la pareja, se reúne con Aleksandr, el exnovio de Rita e instructor del centro náutico, y le da su bendición para reconquistarla... con una condición: deshacerse de Pyotr.

Esta es la historia de amor de una mujer fuerte; Serafima, quien está en un triángulo amoroso. Durante veinte años, su rival y ella han amado al mismo hombre. Además de melodrama, también muestra la vida cotidiana. Un relato sobre la historia de Rusia a través de los ojos de una persona. El destino de Serafima refleja la historia de todo el país: desde la época soviética, la perestroika, hasta la época actual.

Sima queda embarazada de Víctor. Tras una pelea, él es herido y ella lo cuida. Irina, la chica que Víctor ama, descubre la verdad y lo deja. Víctor y Sima se casan, pero él solo espera el nacimiento del bebé.
El hijo de Sima nace con una grave enfermedad del corazón. Víctor la culpa. Sima busca ayuda médica en Moscú y conoce a una periodista que duda que un cirujano famoso la opere.
Irina y Víctor retoman su romance. Sima acude al cirujano Krasin por su hijo y termina salvándolo de un atentado. Agradecido, Krasin acepta operar al niño.

The year is 1348. Europe has fallen under the shadow of the Black Death. As the plague decimates all in its path, fear and superstition are rife.
Bonnie & Clyde meet the epic Vampire in this duel to the death.
After finding mysterious video clips, Lynn returns home to investigate a homicide and uncovers a disturbing secret in her Texas town.
A group of misfits acquire a rare tape with terrifying footage and are confronted with a dead body.
Mysterious VHS tapes with horrific contents are found in a missing student's abandoned house.
A stream of police cars chasing after a deranged ice cream truck driver has captivated the attention of the greater Los Angeles area.

Film censor Enid (Niamh Algar, Wrath of Man) is assigned to review a disturbing film that recalls her childhood memories. She begins to unravel how this eerie work might be tied to the long-ago disappearance of her sister.
A psychic using occult practices to communicate with the dead experiences an evil beyond human comprehension.

Tomaz, an ex-soldier is living in a decaying house, inhabited by a young woman and her dying mother. He starts to fall for his new companion but cannot ignore his suspicion that something insidious might also be living alongside them.
In this genre-bending thriller of spiritual warfare, a young Jesus is thrust into his first confrontation with demonic forces.

ANA and her team of social justice investigators, in their quest to free an innocent man, search an abandoned campground for the identity of the real killer. Unbeknownst to them, they are being hunted.
A 26-chapter anthology that showcases death in all its vicious wonder and brutal beauty.
26 new stories about death from the next generation of genre filmmakers.
Beautiful vampire Djuna tries to resist the advances of the handsome, human screenwriter Paolo, but eventually gives in to their passion.

The women of Drovers Run are determined to discover who killed Harry Ryan..
Taking a short cut along the route, Moira is horrified when her petrol tanker has a dangerous fuel spill.
Steve is busy trying to tie up loose ends before her trial begins, and Fiona joins the CFS.
Stevie's daughter is coming to stay for a month, and it's the first time they've seen each other in two years.
Rose secretly begins seeing Leo, unaware of his history with Stevie.
After Rose and Stevie enthusiastically prepare dinner for Rose's "mystery man," the girls are horrified.
Jodi has introduced Boer goats onto Drovers and wants to associate them with Gungellan Fresh.
When Alex returns from the city with Fiona, Stevie fears he's changed his mind about leaving his wife.
Jodi wakes from a nightmare about fleeing from the hitman with Rob. Stevie wakes alone and full of remorse.
After being offered a two-year research job in Africa, Dave tries to pretend he isn't interested.
After learning of Dave's plan to move to Africa, Kate realises she still has feelings for him.
It's shearing time at Drovers Run and Jodi is happy until her conflicted feelings for Rob recently returned.
Kate's romantic exit has stirred up some confusing emotions for Jodi.
Jodi is spooked by a mysterious vision and develops an angry rash on her wrists and ankles.
Alex and Marcus come to blows over the future of Killarney, and Marcus reveals a secret.
Jodi questions her sanity when she is haunted by visions of her ancestor Emma McLeod and a murdered convict.
Jodi has her hands full with a major decision when both Riley and Matt declare their love for her.
For Jodi and Matt, love is blossoming, and the world is looking remarkably sunny.
Kate has a hard time coming to grips with her best friend's death.
When Regan's sister Grace inherits part of Drovers Run from Jodi, Regan tries to reconcile with her.
Alex's plan to propose to Stevie goes horribly wrong.
When sheep rustlers steal Drovers' breeding stock, Grace and Stevie take the law into their own hands.
Richanne is pregnant at a bad time and Paola's career is in danger.
Jackie is embarrassed by a scandal and Tessa is afraid of her parents.
News of Sandra's pregnancy may threaten her relationship with her kids.
Ashley fears her family's disapproval and Amatulla is ashamed of herself.
Jen fears a repeat of a traumatic event and Chanda fears her parents.
Bethany is pregnant and the father has a second pregnancy on the side.
Amy is hiding her 9th pregnancy and is scared she won't be able to afford.
Kelly's miscarriages have her afraid and Lauren fears her dad's reaction.
Kanchana fears being pushed away and Susannah's parents don't understand.
Carmen confronts a second pregnancy and Jerline gets her life in order.
Krystal keeps a secret and Danie fears her baby will be rejected.
Two women hiding pregnancies fear losing financial support and more.

programmes.t: Help! I'm Turning Into a Giant
programmes.d: Tanya suffers from a condition that causes the body to grow uncontrollably.
A couple has begun the search to find a cure for his unusual condition.
Follow Sultan Kosen of Turkey as he searches for a cure for his gigantism.
Twenty-six-year-old Jyoti is the smallest woman in the world.

programmes.t: The Tiniest Girl in the World
programmes.d: Two-year-old toddler Charlotte weighs only seven pounds.
Fifty-eight-year-old Ronnie and Donnie Galyon need round-the-clock care.
Fifty-eight-year-old Ronnie and Donnie Galyon need round-the-clock care.
Conjoined twins Maria and Theresa were declared doomed when they were born.
Kendra and Maliyah Herrin were born attached at the abdomen and pelvis.
Follow three sets of conjoined twins and their lives after separation.
Defying doctors' grim diagnoses, Kenadie focuses on the best possible life.

programmes.t: Growing Up Tiny: Kenadie's Next Chapter
programmes.d: Seven-year-old Kenadie confronts the possibility of early puberty.
Three of the tallest teenagers in America discuss their various challenges.
Follow the incredible story of three girls who have stopped aging.
A woman's arm burns from the inside out.
Doctors try to diagnose a mystery condition that has deformed a man's head.
A man is born with his heart outside his rib cage.
A man with cold-like symptoms loses his limbs and lips.
A teenager with a scale-like skin condition is desperate for relief.
A teenage girl sleeps for weeks at a time and an artist gets a bionic arm.
A man with a leg that weighs more than 200 pounds seeks a diagnosis.
A man with a crippling skin condition lives life on his own terms.
Doctors attempt to separate a pair of conjoined twins at the head.
A man with half a torso learns if his rare bone-eating disease is back.
A man whose body is eating itself hopes surgery can save his life.
A baby born with eight limbs undergoes groundbreaking surgery.
A woman hopes a tooth transplant in her eye will stop her from going blind.
An eleven-year-old boy is 6-feet-9-inches tall and still growing.
A woman who cries blood is desperate for a diagnosis.
A man's body blows up like a balloon after a diving accident.
A young boy lives with an agonizing skin condition.
A teenager hiding a rare condition hopes surgery will lead to normal life.
A man has thousands of bubble-like growths covering every inch of his body.
A man with a life-threatening face tumor must conquer his fear of surgery.
A man has surgery on a huge tumor, and a woman with a giant leg finds love.
A boy with undeveloped legs walks on all fours.
A full-face transplant patient battles a second life-threatening challenge.

Your official gateway to the underground. Discover your first distorted riff or find a circle of peers who "get it." Welcome to the neighborhood—it’s loud, it’s proud, and there’s always room for one more.

Welcome to the ultimate pit. Metalcore Madness brings you the visual pulse of metalcore and deathcore—packed with blistering solos, heavy breakdowns, and raw energy. Turn it up, open the pit, and let the madness take over!

A cerebral explosion of technical wizardry and complex structures. Dive into a fusion of dizzying riffs, odd time signatures, and soaring melodies as masters of their craft redefine metal's limits in this experimental sound lab.

Leave the rock anthems at the door—this is 100% pure steel. We’ve dialed the distortion to eleven for a lineup strictly for the heavy-duty fans. No compromises, no fillers, just total sonic devastation.

programmes.t: The Adventures Of Priscilla, Queen Of The Desert
programmes.d: A wonderfully inventive Australian comedy about three drag performers braving the vast, rugged outback.
In this madcap farce, two Chicago musicians disguise themselves as women to avoid the mob.
The true story of the infamous 1919 Chicago White Sox scandal, when the team throws the World Series.
Baseball season gets off to a rocky start when a veteran catcher and cocky young pitcher compete over a woman.
To prove himself, Igor, a mad scientist's assistant, creates a sweet, show-tune-singing monster.

Greetings, Earthlings. A pint-sized extraterrestrial has just landed on Earth by accident...and he's feeling a little, well, alienated because he got separated from his family. But MAC will transform the lives of everyone he meets...forever!
A playboy (Richard Gere) has never thought about commitment until he meets Charlotte (Winona Ryder).
A hotel manager risks his life and his family to take in over 1,000 refugees during the 1994 Rwandan genocide.
Boxer Jake La Motta's life is filled with violence both in out of the ring in this masterpiece.
A sound-effects man witnesses and records a car accident that turns deadly...for him.
Classic sci-fi adventure about a cop...part man...part machine...the future of law enforcement.
When Alex Murphy is critically injured, OmniCorp sees their chance for a part-man, part-robot police officer.
Philip Marlowe faces the most bizarre case of his life, when a friend's suicide turns into a double murder.
Marlene Dietrich stars in an exceptional courtroom drama about a man on trial for a wealthy widow's murder.
A lone juror must convince eleven others that a teen accused of murder is innocent.
A widowed nurse (Lucille Ball) and her EIGHT kids get together with a widower (Henry Fonda) and his TEN kids!
This comedy gem introduces Jacques Clouseau, the clumsiest Inspector ever to trip over a case!
Bumbling Inspector Clouseau must find a high-profile culprit quickly, or his career will be finit!

programmes.t: The Return Of The Pink Panther
programmes.d: When the Pink Panther Diamond is stolen from a museum, the intrepid Inspector Clouseau is on the case.

When an explosion jolts Boston, bomb squad expert Jimmy Dove (Jeff Bridges) is thrust into the most harrowing work of his career. And when evidence points to his former mentor (Tommy Lee Jones), Dove must face a bitter enemy and a haunting past.

As members of the Los Angeles Police Department's elite anti-gang unit, a seasoned cop (Robert Duvall) and his new partner (Sean Penn) are called in to assist with the crackdown against the mounting gang violence in the slums of East Los Angeles.
A one-woman vigilante force is out for revenge against those who hooked her sister on drugs.
Foxy Brown (Pam Grier) vows vengeance against those responsible for the death of an undercover officer.

When Cole (Franco Nero), a westerner trained in the deadly fighting rituals of Ninjitsu, is suddenly dragged into a dangerous dispute with an oil baron, he must face the best assassin money can buy, Ninja Hasegawa (martial arts legend Sho Kosugi)!

When a band of Ninja assassins slaughters the family of Cho Osaki (Sho Kosugi), he flees to America in the hope of building a new life. Osaki tries to escape his deadly past but soon discovers he has become the pawn of a ruthless drug trafficker.

Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi thriller as Gibson Rickenbacker, the future's most fearsome warrior. In the wake of a plague, Rickenbacker must rescue the only person who can develop a vaccine and save civilization.

In the role that kicked his international career into high gear, Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as Frank Dux, a man who refuses to lose and who might just win himself a place in history as he competes in a full-contact world championship competition.

Superstar Jean-Claude Van Damme is Louis Burke, an undercover detective who is investigating a series of murders at a penitentiary. But when he unearths a shocking secret, he must attempt a daring escape that pits him against an enemy from his past!

Jean-Claude Van Damme leaps into dual roles of Chad and Alex Wagner, twin brothers separated after their parents’ brutal murder. Twenty-five years later, fate reunites them and ignites their determination to exact revenge... with two times the pain.

Chow Yun Fat and Seann William Scott star in this heart-pumping action-adventure when a mysterious Tibetan monk, who has protected a powerful scroll for 60 years, believes he has found his successor in a pick-pocketing, streetwise punk.
A vicious gang forces Akira to shed his quiet persona and reveal his other identity...that of a skilled Ninja!

When his partner is killed during a drug bust, a federal agent throws away his badge and the rule book with it. Arming himself with an array of deadly weaponry including nunchucks and ninja stars, he sets out to settle the score with the bad guys.

Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) is no victim: He fights back – with a vengeance! After beginning a new life in L.A., Kersey's daughter is viciously assaulted. Now, he won't rest until he tracks the assailants down...and puts them all in the ground!

A battle-weary Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) longs to leave his fighting days behind him. But when he arrives in New York to visit a friend and finds him brutally attacked, the silent avenger must wage war again in this no-holds-barred thriller!

Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) is on a mission to take down the L.A. drug trade after his girlfriend's teenage daughter tragically dies of an overdose. He's armed and dangerous...and mad as hell in this take-no-prisoners, pulse-pounding thriller.

programmes.t: Death Wish V: The Face Of Death
programmes.d: Former vigilante Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) has moved back to New York and is leading a quiet life. But when his beautiful fiancee (Lesley-Anne Down) is killed, once again upholding the law becomes his way of life...and this time it's for good!
Tupac Shakur and James Belushi are two corrupt police detectives caught in a dangerous web of deceit in this gritty, smart and tough action thriller.
Two prison escapees on the lam race against time to find a hidden cache of cash and an incriminating computer disk.

programmes.t: Harley Davidson And The Marlboro Man
programmes.d: Mickey Rourke and Don Johnson star in this four-lane genre collision of biker movie, heist thriller, buddy flick and sci-fi pic that will take you to the hardline of action and adventure! Co-starring Tom Sizemore, Chelsea Field and Vanessa Williams.

A hellish hound feeds upon the flesh of the heirs of Baskerville Hall. But before this beast can sink its teeth into the newest lord, it must pit its vicious fangs against the searing intellect of Sherlock Holmes (Peter Cushing) and Dr. Watson.
When a nightclub entrepreneur gets taken out by the mob, his girlfriend calls upon a voodoo high priest to carry out an unholy plan for revenge.

The eternally cool William Marshall puts a fresh spin on the age-old legend of the vampire, condemned to wander the Earth with an insatiable lust for blood in "Blacula," often credited as the first African American horror film.

Brought back to the world of the living by a voodoo ceremony Blacula (William Marshall) is loosed with insatiable bloodlust upon the population of a small community in the Louisiana back country. Pam Grier also stars in this scintillating sequel
Horror legend Vincent Price plays the sole survivor of a plague that turns humans into vampire-like zombies...and his life into an endless nightmare!

Discover the true meaning of survival of the fittest as a terrifying creature from the past brings the future to its knees in this Danish-American kaiju creature feature about a cold-blooded 90-foot killer whose time has come... again!

In South Korea's first entry into the kaiju genre, a monstrous creature creates destruction throughout Korea as scientists race against time to create a refrigerant that may be the only weapon to stop the monster before it destroys the country!
It's angry, hungry, well-armed and ready to sample the local cuisine! John Huston, Shelley Winters and Henry Fonda star in this gripping thriller!
Shelley Winters puts the Grande in Grande Dame Guignol in director Curtis Harrington's atmospheric, suspenseful and surprisingly moving cult chiller.
In this cult-classic thriller, Kay Lenz and Shelley Winters star as a co-ed and the witchy head of a sorority who has special plans for the new girl.
When a horror novelist tries to "kill off" his successful author pseudonym, he finds his alter ego on a greusome quest for revenge.
An rookie FBI agent goes up against a brutal serial killer...and a cannibalistic psychiatrist.
Hannibal Lecter comes out of hiding to draw Agent Clarice Starling into a high-stakes battle.
Suppose a stranger told you that your daughter was his child reincarnated. Anthony Hopkins and Marsha Mason star in this hair-raising occult thriller.

65 years after a serial killer terrorized the town of Texarkana, the so-called 'moonlight murders' begin again. Is it a copycat or something even more sinister? A lonely high school girl, with dark secrets of her own, may be the key to catching him.

Newcomer Steve (James Marsden) is cautioned by Gavin Strick (Nick Stahl) about the Blue Ribbons, a club of robotic, perfect students who rule the school. When Gavin turns into a "perfect" himself, Steve and Rachel Wagner (Katie Holmes) investigate.

The Calvin Finishing School for Girls is closed for Christmas vacation.  However, Mrs. Jensen (the housemother), five teenage girls and their mischievous male companions are all that remain at the school...or are they?

This New Year's, you're invited to a killer party...While the host of a punk-rock TV show is broadcasting live, she begins receiving calls on-air from a psychopath who's planning to kill a "naughty girl" as midnight strikes in each U.S. time zone!
Colonel West returns from an historic trip to Saturn with a strange ailment: his flesh is melting! And only human flesh and blood will keep him alive!
The streets of London are transformed into a smorgasbord for an alien creature with a taste for human flesh. Don't just panic…run for your lives!

When a rocket lands on Mars, the crew finds the planet not entirely dead. As the team begins to explore, they are attacked by horrific and demented creatures at every turn. Battling for their lives, can the survivors make it back to their ship?

John Saxon, Dennis Hopper and the legendary Basil Rathbone star in this atmospheric -- and influential -- sci-fi cult classic as a team of astronauts embark upon a rescue mission to Mars only to encounter a seductive alien, The Queen of Blood!
Chaos reigns on the wide open plains as Burt Lancaster and Lee Remick let loose in this comedy that spoofs nearly every convention of movie westerns.

Sydney Pollack directs Burt Lancaster, Shelley Winters, Ossie Davis and Telly Savalas in this lively and ribald western about a frontier-wise fur trapper who loses his pelts to a band of Kiowas in exchange for a slave he doesn't want.

Welcome to America's Wild - and very wacky - West! Burt Reynolds, Clint Walker, Ossie Davis and Angie Dickinson star in this tongue-in-cheek tale of love, lust and larceny as an amiable con-artist is hire by a sexy widow to break into the U.S. Mint.

Burt Reynolds, Aldo Sambrell and Fernando Rey star in this lusty, gutsy action western about a fearless Indian with a relentless vendetta against the band of outlaws that killed his people. Directed by Spaghetti Western legend Sergio Corbucci.
A fast-shooting gunman and an insurance agent track down the murdering robbers of a train hijacking and the stolen money.

East Meets West in this charming spaghetti western in which three petty crooks try to transform an East Coast dandy into a real Wild West man! Starring Terrence Hill, Gregory Walcott, Harry Carey Jr. and Dominic Barto and directed by Enzo Barboni!

A man recently released from a five-year prison sentence seeks vengeance against the former friend who has violated his trust and sought his death. Starring Thomas Hunter, Henry Silva, and Dan Duryea.

Lee Van Cleef and  John Phillip Law star in this bona fide Spaghetti Western classic as, fifteen years after bandits massacred his family, a young man seeking revenge forms an unlikely alliance with the outlaw who was framed for the murders.

Mercenary Sergei Kowalski (Franco Nero) joins up with a Mexican revolutionary Paco Roman (Tony Musante) to rob a silver mine and bring new order to Mexico by force! Jack Palance and Giovanna Ralli co-star in this brilliant spaghetti western.

The results are explosive when an Irish terrorist (James Coburn) with a dynamite obsession teams up with a Mexican peasant-turned- revolutionary (Rod Steiger) in this action-packed tale of power and politics. Directed by the legendary Sergio Leone.

programmes.t: A Reason To Live, A Reason To Die
programmes.d: From director Tonino Valerii comes this top-notch spaghetti western set during the Civil War where eight condemned Union prisoners attempt to capture a Missouri fort from Confederate soldiers. James Coburn, Telly Savalas and Bud Spencer star.

James Coburn portrays an aging, philandering rodeo cowboy who returns to his hometown. He must do battle not only in the rodeo arena, but with his desire for personal independence and his contradictory desire to win the respect of his wife and son.

Jack (Jeff Bridges) and Cecil (Sam Waterston) are an oddball team of modern-day Montana cattle rustlers, and they've set their sights on a pair of unlikely ranch owners from New York (Clifton James, Elizabeth Ashley). But can they outfox the foxes?

Get ready for fast-paced, explosive action as Lee Van Cleef stars as Sabata, the mysterious, steely-eyed gunslinger who, after he discovers the masterminds behind an elaborate bank heist, imposes his bullet-laced brand of justice on a guilty town.

Under the brutal rule of garrison leader Col. Skimmel, a group of Mexican revolutionaries hire gunslinger Sabata (Yul Brynner) to rob a transport of gold in order to buy weapons. But the Colonel has other plans...taking the gold for himself.

The great Lee Van Cleef ("Death Rides a Horse") returns as the famous freewheeling gunslinger Sabata. In this third and final go-round for the enigmatic sharpshooter, Sabata seeks revenge when a band of desperadoes bilks him out of $5,000.

Rod Cameron plays a Western explorer with a unique scheme--to open a new desert route by using camels as pack animals. His trek is imperiled by a phony law-avoiding doctor (John Ireland) and his woman (Joanne Dru), a search for water and attacking Indians.
Five Civil War outlaws must brave hostile Comanche territory – and a cunning woman – to hijack a stagecoach carrying a traitor...and $30,000 in gold!

Seeking a fresh start, Bat Masterson (Joel McCrea) rolls into Dodge City with a chip on his shoulder and a gun on his hip. But soon, his mysterious past will catch up with him when an old friend calls in a favor...one that might cost him his life!

Sharpshooter Matthew Quigley (Tom Selleck) thinks he's been hired to kill wild dogs in Australia. But a wealthy cattle baron (Alan Rickman) has far more nefarious plans for the sharpshooter. Laura San Giacomo also stars in this stylish western.

As the hunt for the bomb-maker intensifies, Adam races to save the life of one of his team.
MI5 take action to stop an MP from winning their first parliamentary seat.
MI5 discover that an Islamic terrorist is planning to enter the UK and launch an attack.
Harry discovers an ex-MI5 officer’s suicide was staged and vows to avenge his murder.

programmes.t: JUST MOVE! ENDING THE COUCH POTATO PANDEMIC
programmes.d: Lack of physical activity is a growing problem, with over 50% of adults and 80% of young people in high-income countries being insufficiently active. The documentary JUST MOVE! ENDING THE COUCH POTATO PANDEMIC shows how we can reignite the desire for movement and overcome inactivity.

Cancer survivor and filmmaker Erik E. Crown joins local water activists to investigate accelerated cancer rates and other illnesses in central Florida communities, tracing the source to phosphate mining and the pollution of the state's waterways by a multinational corporation.

Los piques ilegales siguen causando muertes y accidentes graves, dejando víctimas inocentes. A pesar de no estar tipificados como delito, aumentan la inseguridad, lo que genera demandas por leyes más estrictas para frenar esta práctica peligrosa.

En el hospital El Salvador de Ubaté, muertes de bebés por negligencia médica se acumulan entre 2022 y 2023. Padres denuncian diagnósticos erróneos y falta de insumos. La Gerente, ya señalada en un caso anterior, es el blanco de las acusaciones.

Alexis Mesa, un actor cubano en Barcelona, fue drogado y robado por un hombre que conoció en Grindr. La sustancia usada, GHB, también fue hallada en cuatro hombres homosexuales asesinados en Bilbao. El sospechoso, Nelson David Moreno Bolaños, fue detenido y enfrenta juicio por estos crímenes.

Gladys y César descubren inconsistencias en sus casas prefabricadas en Medellín y Chinauta. Alba recibe amenazas tras desistir del contrato. Rocio y Sebastián investigan con cámara oculta. Constructora Ksas y Dinami Casa enfrentan denuncias por incumplimientos y estafas. Las víctimas luchan por justicia.
Un amor pasajero entre Flaminio Báez y María del Tránsito Veloza resulta en el nacimiento de un hijo con problemas médicos y una batalla de por vida.

Desde 2023 Colombia vive una ola de violencia en sus carreteras. Trágicos asesinatos y los crecientes asaltos y homicidios en el transporte intermunicipal, la inseguridad en las vías es un reflejo de la indiferencia gubernamental.

Desde su inicio en 1996, Séptimo Día ha sido un referente del periodismo investigativo en Colombia. Historias arriesgadas, denuncias impactantes y la valentía de sus reporteros han marcado el rumbo de una televisión que no teme confrontar la verdad.

En 2014, en Santana, Huila, Jorge Cangrejo fue secuestrado y baleado en la cabeza por sus captores, quienes lo enterraron creyéndolo muerto. Milagrosamente sobrevivió y se convirtió en aliado clave de las autoridades para identificar a los responsables. Dos victimarios permanecen detenidos, acusados de tentativa de homicidio, porte ilegal de armas y secuestro simple agravado, enfrentando hasta 40 años de prisión.

En una vereda de Cimitarra, Santander, Pedro Suta se obsesiona con Irene, esposa de su jefe Arcilio. Tras ser rechazado, la asesina junto a su hijo menor, decapitándola y desmembrando al niño. Ese día, Arcilio estaba de viaje con otro hijo por un tratamiento médico. Al descubrirse las desapariciones, la comunidad se alerta e inicia una intensa búsqueda para dar con el responsable del doble homicidio.
Ana Rosa García, venezolana de 24 años, fue hallada muerta el 7 de julio de 2020 en Inírida. Su ex, Alexander Matiz, obsesionado con ella, fue identificado por registros telefónicos y capturado.

En 2014, en Bogotá, Valentina Maldonado, de 15 años, murió al estallar una granada lanzada contra su vivienda mientras dormía junto a su madre. La investigación reveló que el objetivo real era su madre, considerada un obstáculo por Marcos Andrés Roldán, quien tenía una obsesión con la adolescente. Cinco personas fueron condenadas entre 14 y 20 años de prisión por homicidio.
Una niña indígena es asesinada cerca de la Sierra Nevada. Se investiga y descubren la implicación de su primo y Nefer Niño, este último contratado por celos. La investigación revela más tras 7 meses.
El asesinato del niño Luis Santiago en Chía (Cundinamarca).
El 23 de junio de 2014 en Chinchiná, Alfair Sabogal atacó brutalmente a seis miembros de una familia por celos e intentó matar a su pareja, Diana Marín, quien quedó con secuelas visuales.

Damien demanda a Sal por 35 millones de dólares, alegando que el servicio de transporte de Sal arruinó su matrimonio al dejar a su esposa en la casa de su amante. Sal niega la culpa y prioriza el crecimiento empresarial.
Mario está demandando a la psíquica del vecindario, Lydia, por $30,000 y la imposición negligente de angustia emocional después de prometer eliminar su maldición ... por una tarifa.
Alexa está demandando a su novio de un año y medio por cancelar abruptamente el viaje de su vida porque necesitaba traer a su hijo de 7 años.

Michelle está demandando a Michael y Nuri por negligencia y pérdida comercial después de que su spa de alta gama se dañó cuando los lechones de Michael y Nuri fueron liberados y se volvieron locos en su negocio.
Miguel está demandando a su ex novia, Jasmine, por la totalidad de los $5 millones que ella ganó a través de un boleto instantáneo que compró con su tarjeta de crédito.

La redención de Orlando narra su lucha de 22 años con la drogadicción, su paso por la policía durante el cartel de Medellín, y su vuelta a la vida como ejemplo tras rehabilitarse y recomponerse con su familia.

En 2020, Ximena y José, estudiantes en México, fueron asesinados tras un carnaval. Un sombrero azul ligado al crimen llevó a la captura de una criminal. Sus familias buscan justicia mientras el juicio fue retrasado por la pandemia.

Hace dos años, Chelsea admitió que engañaba en secreto a su novio Corey con su amigo, pero él la perdonó. ¿Necesita saber quién es el padre de su bebé? ¡Entonces, Liz y Bailey se han unido gracias a Josh como padre de sus hijos!
Estas parejas decidieron hacer un trío que terminó en un embarazo. Ahora que los bebés han nacido, estos hombres niegan ser los padres. Hoy se verán obligados a reconocer la verdad.

The first heat of the Fifth Wars raises the bar for action. With newcomers outnumbering the veterans, will and underdog manage to secure a place in the finals?

One newcomer gets a forceful yet thorough tour of the arena hazards in the eliminators. Flippers prove to be this heats weapon of choice and they are put to great effect, as many robots take to the air.

The eliminators continue as more newcomers and veterans enter the arena, ready to destroy each other for the spot in the finals. One competitor’s design renders their adversary’s weapon useless, can they adapt, or will they be wiped out?
More flipping action as we witness one of the quickest immobilisations in Robot Wars history. A house robot gets a little too eager when trying to pit a competitor.

More hopefuls enter the arena, as they risk life and limb for a chance at the finals. An equally matched battle leaves the decisions to the judges, and two house robots work together to inflict some last minute damage.

Halfway through the heats and the competition is on fire, literally. The arena is out for revenge after another competitor inadvertently vandalises it. One robot commits the ultimate sin, attacking the benevolent Refbot.

The house robots venture into the funeral business as they hold cremations and burials in the Robot Wars arena, to the applause of a live audience. One flip may spell doom early on for one competitor.

One competitor achieves every flipper robot’s dream in this episode’s heats, rapidly ending the first round. Another robot refuses to go into the pit alone and takes down whoever they can get grip on.

One competitor gets chopped up by competitor and house robot alike and a quick eviction from the arena makes the judge’s job a simple one. A seemingly one-sided fight takes a different direction, thanks to the hazardous arena.

When the competitor’s weapons aren’t quite doing the job, they must resort to using the arena to secure the win. There’s not enough room for the both of them, which robot from the Isle of Sheppey will prove itself the best in this chance encounter.
World Champions meet a newcomer in this episode’s heat, will it be an easy appetiser, or a major upset? One uneventful round leaves the house robots responsible for entertaining the crowd.
The last heats of the fifth series. Matilda breaks the rules and strays from her zone, inflicting massive damage on unsuspecting robots, much to the dismay of the judges.

The semi-finals are here and the competitors step up a notch, even the house robots need to be cautious. One of the three losers of the first rounds have an opportunity for redemption in the Losers Melee.

After this episode, the Grand Final lineup will be decided. With pressure mounting the robots are going all out. One competitor is sent to the clouds with the help of another. The house robots help decide who makes it to through.
This episode, Robot Wars: The Fifth Wars will have a champion. As the proven best robots of the series gather one last time, the competition has never been more evenly matched.

Dynamic duo Craig Charles and Philippa Forrester are back for the Sixth Wars. Two-time World champions and Fifth Wars Champions compete in this explosive first episode, will their hopes be dashed at the start?

The competitors waste no time getting stuck into the fray in the four way melees, with one robot seemingly dominating the competition. The house robots may be a little rusty as a robot launches an attack.
Former two-time UK champion returns to the arena, and after losing its title in the last series, they have a score to settle. Will another robot foil their plans and take their spot in the finals?

The four way melee shows how closely matched the robots are in a nail-biting first round. Mr Psycho gets an opportunity to use his colossal hammer against a competitor. The arena suffers more damage from one of the robots devastating weapon.

Eight more competitors take on the four way melees to try and secure a spot in the final. A robot seemingly eliminates itself from the competition. The judges make difficult decisions in yet another well-matched heat.
One newcomer braves the arena against seven veterans in this heat. Mr. Psycho continues to smash any robot unfortunate to get close, cementing his position as a feared house robot.

In order to save the publishing company where she works from being sold, junior editor Becca has to travel to Arcania with famed action star Lee to secure the movie rights to the popular "Lover's Quest" series.

A young, flirtatious barista is bored with her social lifestyle and longs for real love. So when an eligible, handsome guy walks into her coffee shop, she turns on the charm, but he doesn’t respond to her flirting like men usually do. When she discovers that he runs a ministry that builds affordable housing, she decides to volunteer.

A lonely teacher (Amber) is hired by Connor, the single father of a struggling student. She is to tutor his daughter Macey (age 10) over a summer while they travel for his work. As Amber helps Macey, she sees glimpses of what’s missing in the family’s life. Their grand destinations are filled with rich items and potential rewarding business deals, but it’s missing heart. Amber’s influence fills the void and brings Macey and Connor together. With it, Amber starts to fall in love with Connor, but

Juliet pitches Christmas candles to her boss to earn a promotion and enlists the help of Tom, a candle store owner. He refuses at first but agrees when he realizes the money will help make his daughter's Christmas wish come true.

Like many projects, this 1954 Chevy 3100 restoration has stalled. So, we’re going to help this owner pickup the pieces on this project by installing a new 350 engine, completely overhaul the front end, and bolt-on new bumpers. After were done, this truck will be ready to get wired and fired.

Sometimes Bruno will do a favor for a fellow Race Car Driver friend. That’s why Top Fuel driver Clay Millican’s old Dodge Cummins is in the shop. Like everything Clay drives, this truck is tortured and has broke a few things. Matt and Bruno get to play pit today on Truck U.

Bruno and Matt have earned some vacation time, but before they get to take a break they need to finish work on the 2012 Toyota Tacoma 4wd. The guys transform a Toyota into a Expedition vehicle that can light up any path in its way.

The guys have a Mini Cooper S in the shop today.  They add some horsepower, some stopping power, and fix up a worn-out suspension to improve handling. Then they see if they can even fit in it for the test drive!
Kevin and Willie have a problematic Trailblazer in the shop today. They tackle multiple issues and get it up and runnin’ again.  The guys also kick start a performance build project on a Gen5 Camaro!
The guys have a 6 Speed 2015 Mustang GT in the shop and they’re adding some power by installing a cold air intake, an exhaust package, a tune, and a … thermostat?
Kevin and Willie are working on a build again, but this time it’s no work truck! They’re diving in head first on a 550 Horsepower Cobra Replica Kit Car!
Kevin and Willie have a Gen 1 Camaro in the shop and their work is cut out for them! They’re installing a new sub frame, rack and pinion, brakes, gauges … and that’s just half of the work!
The Gen 1 Camaro is back in the shop and the guys still have a lot to do if they want to finish this build!
Drivers start your engines! This week, Kevin takes a trip to racing country.  We’re giving you a backstage look at WeatherTech’s Porsche Race Team and their North Carolina racing facility.
The guys install a stiffer suspension on this Mustang to help get it ready for power adders and they toss on a new exhaust to sweeten its sound.
It’s time for the ultimate axle reconstructive surgery.We install brand new Dana 44 axles on a 2008 Jeep Jk 4 wheel drive.
Matt and Bruno install a portable bedwood kit on a collector 1946 Ford Truck and we give the truck a mini restoration under the hood.
Don’t wait till your factory warranty is up to modify your truck. We’ll show you how to add power and personality while staying street legal.
Matt and Bruno take a stock Ram and add bigger wheels and tires. A new grill and makes some new friends along the way.
If you’re not prepared to break off-road, you might as well not even play. We’ll show you what “must-have” parts you need to recover your off-road vehicle.
First, a Jeep Rubicon gets a power convertible top and then our YJ project gets stripped down to the frame.
After a Canyon is saved from the side of the road, Matt and Bruno find the fix in a new crate LS Engine.
Our YJ Project starts going back together with an all new Jeep tub and body. A much needed leaf spring kit and other interior accessories.
Kevin services a tournament series high performance boat while Bryan welds up a new casting platform.
Kevin and Bryan hit the road and take in a classic auto show and take a tour at Monster Transmission and Performance.
Kevin and Bryan show us the proper way to upgrade the power steering system on an older vehicle and offer some other useful maintenance tips.
Bryan takes a trip to Huntington Beach, CA to learn some new detailing tips from the pros.
Kevin and Bryan take a Lexus IS250 and add the latest FSport performance products from front to back -  taking IS performance to the next level.
Ken Schrader drops off a 2004 Corvette that is in need of some TLC.
Kevin calls on his friends at Green Earth Technologies to learn about G-Oil and see how it is made.
Kevin and Bryan throw a couple hundred horses at a 2010 Camaro pace car with a new supercharger.
When your work truck gets wrecked, your ability to work stops. Matt and Bruno take on a project to get a work truck back on the road with some body work and repair.

Matt and Bruno ‘s Jeep project is going to be a beast when they get finished with it. The guys install a supercharger and a long arm suspension to give it some life, and they finish it up with a new exhaust and a mean front bumper that will provide the “bite.”  Then, the beast is unleashed!
Matt and Bruno do some custom fabrication to a build stage CJ 7. They also run new fuel lines and drop in a new fuel tank.
A lot can wrong in a Diesel trucks fuel delivery system. Today we look at corrosion in the lines and stuck injectors, to see if we can solve the problems with a secret.

We love bolt on power, so today is going to be fun. We've got a Roush Supercharger kit, with an exhaust and intake to install on this stock 2012 F150. Then we’ll put it on the road and burn some rubber.
Matt and Bruno take a stock TJ and make it into the machine it was born to be. Once we upgrade the Steering and Suspension, we’ll make some much needed repair.

We are in Alanya, on Turkey’s south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season of Strongman Champions League. Here in the sunshine, we’ll finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is. You could not ask for a better setting. After months of hard-work, if not years for some of these lads, we find out who will take the world title.

Welcome, to day two of the strongman champions league 2022 finals here in Alanya, Turkey. It’s all up for grabs now, everyone is fighting for the world title belt. This is an epic episode where we finally crown the World champion of 2022.

Welcome to the 2023 Strongman Champions League in Vaasa, Finland! This year’s event introduces a knockout format with 6 intense events over 90 minutes, ending in a unique deadlift face-off with boats.

Stage 2 of the Strongman Champions League 2023 is set in Zrenjanin, Serbia. This exciting event features 5 challenging contests, including a superhuman Yoke race. As the SCL World Series Tour continues, athletes will battle it out to claim the yellow leader’s position for the season. Don’t miss this incredible stage of strength and endurance!

The World’s Strongest Team will be crowned in this edition of SCL, here in Kalajoki-Finland we’ve picked some of the best in the business, teamed them up, and they’ll be going all out against each other. It’s now no longer about being a lonely wolf, but more about the pack mentality. It is a competition over 7 events, including a Big 2-man Log lift and heavy deadlift. Let’s start the action.

Strongman Champions League in Holland at the Dru Factory in ULFT. A great location for a spectacular battle with 14 Athletes over 3 events! The first 3 events in this episode are Truckpull/ Superyoke and Farmerswalk, with 2 massive logs of 150 kg in their hands. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it’s the circus of the extreme.

Ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, strongman fans across the world, we are back for SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it’s about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland, continues with the last 3 events, here at the Dru Factory in ULFT. The events in this episode are the Viking Press, Wheel Flip and the Atlas Stones, with 180 kg in the end.

For the first time ever, the World’s Strongest Latino competition has begun. This two-day event in Porto, Portugal, features 20 athletes from around the world competing in 8 events. After 4 grueling events, the top 12 will advance to the finals.

Strongman Champions League World Record Breakers 2023 starts with a 25-ton snow plow! Crazy machines are pulled and pushed, with many kilograms moved. A few new world records are set in this competition.

We have returned to the powerhouse of Portugal for an edge-of-your-seat galactic battle. If all the planets collided at once, it wouldn’t compare to the bang of this show. Get ready for the battle of the beasts; it’s the heaviest show in the universe, the Strongman Champions League.

SCL UK has landed in Gloucester it is workout war fitness for the ferocious, it’s going to be a a battle of the brutal, a rampage of the roofless. This is going to be a massacre of the muscles. You know it by now, but just in case you don’t, this is strongman champions league.

On the menu this week it’s medieval madness, we’ve come back to the middle ages to test our noble men through a muscle gaining of events. They are hoping and we are hoping that one will survive to take the title of the world’s strongest Viking. The official World's Strongest Viking is this time in Finland.

This week is a good one, can you feel the energy? Sit still, just look at me and try and feel the energy, because I can tell you, the atmosphere here is electric, it’s explosive, there is a pure elemental force going through these athletes' veins. I’m shaking because it’s Poland, it’s powerful, it’s strongman champions league, and you know what I'm going to say, get ready because it’s about to get heavy.

SCL Poland part 2 - Who will win the title in Poland and take 25 points for the world ranking. It is very exciting on the top, in part 1 between Poland and Latvia. Another great episode with super strongman events such as: Bag Toss Medley, Log Lift Reps and the Powerstairs. Also an interview with Mateusz Kieloszkowski, the all time favorite champion from Poland.

It’s time to show our strength and gain respect from the gods of Olympus. Our gladiators have many events set out by no other than Hercules himself. The coliseum is ready here on this mythological island of Cyprus, so we have landed in Limassol were again 12 Top Strongmen are battling for the title and ranking points.

The only and official world championship Truckpulling for its 10th year, again at the Strongman Champions league. With the 3 times Worldchampion Kelvin de Ruiter – defending his title. This championship has trucks in all shapes and sizes which is a lot like our athletes, there all different pay loads, but does the biggest win or is it the strongest.

Years and years of determination has brought us here today, when all the walls felt like they were caving in perseverance. When their bodies were screaming, hurting, shouting stop, beneath. These are the things which make up a man, these are the things that bring you world finalists. This episode they fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever.

Part 2 of the World Finals of the Strongman Champions League tour 2023 at the Sarajevo Centar Skenderija in Bosnia. 3 Events was done already and amazing results have been set. Who will be the new World champion? Find out here, who, after 16 stages, will be crowned World Champion 2023.

After 10 years there is another edition of THE ICEMAN in minus 25 degrees and snow, and it is also the first stage in the MLO Strongman Champions League. With a new World champion from South Africa, Rayno Nel, it will be a challenging year for all the athletes to win the title again after 1 full year. But now they can win one very exceptional title, which is the SCL ICEMAN!

This is our bookmark. Our full stop. It is an actual document of individuality and modern surfing and living and romping and laughing. Collect it and recollect on it. Here we are now, entertain us. And well take it from there.

An anarchist (Frank Whaley), who was once rabidly pro-technology, threatens to blow up the central computers that control the world. As he negotiates with Pete Yastremski (John Amos) to surrender, we discover what led him down this dark path.

When the leader of an Arctic exploration team kills two colleagues, psychologist Jack Burrell (William Cummins) is sent up to counsel the staff, including an old "friend" (Robert Sean Leonard), and to find the cause of an infectious psychosis.

Time-traveler Dr. Theresa Givens (Amanda Plummer) faces the death penalty for using her time machine in a future where all technology is banned due to a devastating nuclear holocaust some 20 years earlier. Charlton Heston also stars.

An overworked father who wants to relieve the tension in his home due to the demands of his job orders a robot to keep house and perform other chores. Much to the father's surprise, the robot starts to replace him as head of the household.

A military colonel travels into the past from a plagued-ridden future where billions have died from a deadly virus. His mission: track down Patient Zero, the woman who had all three strains of DNA that produced the virus and assassinate her.

A couple and their friend join a mysterious religious sect in order to lead a more spiritual existence and find a new direction in life. They soon learn, however, that their new-found direction may take them further than they ever thought possible.

Young and artistic Claire Linkwood, who struggles financially to make ends meet, volunteers for a surrogate mother program. But after the embryo is successfully implanted at the clinic, she begins to have nightmares of a most "alien" nature.

The lone survivor (Jere Burns) of a space shuttle disaster discovers he's greatly transformed since surviving the crash. For one, his body seems to be indestructible, and he embraces a new-found humanity…courtesy of The Outer Limits.

Mona Lisa, an android who was created to spy and kill, is designed with superior intelligence. But it is that superior intellect which allows her to evolve, leading her to question the morality of her prime directive...and her own existence.

A biogeneticist clones successfully his wife, who is near death in a coma with no expectation of survival. But when his real wife suddenly awakens from her coma, he finds life with not one, but two wives may be quite complicated.

A man (Enrico Colantoni) has second thoughts about a process that transmits a copy of a person light years away but requires that the human "shell" left behind be destroyed in order to maintain a balance in the Universe.

An unemployed man wanders into a curio shop owned by a shape-shifting alien and is offered a rather unique wallet...one that fills with the money of anyone the man comes in physical contact with. However, if it's too good to be true, it often is.

A dying scientist (Joanna Going) makes it her mission to save a mutant "child" -- a link to another dimension of time and space -- from those scientists who seek fame and from shadowy government forces that desire to exploit it.

A four-person space crew travels through a wormhole that lands them in an unknown universe where Native American Astrophysicist Callie Whitehorse Landau experiences bizarre hallucinations that reveal the true nature of the entire universe.

When an alien seed travels through space and lands on Earth in a rooftop garden, the exotic "flower" it spawns turns out to be an alluring woman who consumes the life and energy out of human victims in the attempt to perpetuate her species on Earth.

After a botched military experiment some four years earlier resulted in the death of one of the test subjects, a doctor now believes the deceased test subject's vengeful spirit is able to jump from one body to another…and is after her.

In an effort to help the mentally ill, a psychiatrist (Jamie Lunar) creates a device that allows her to enter the subconscious of her patients. But when things go wrong, she finds that her own sanity -- and possibly her life -- may be in danger.

A time traveler recruits a young woman from present day to join a team of time travelers-for-hire, but when she ends up attempting to change her own past, doing irreparable damage to the present and the future, the institute must race to stop her.

When an alien abducts five students and transports them to a reproduction of their school, it informs them that they are part of a grand experiment. But as part of that experiment, together they must decide which of the five should be killed.

A circuit court judge (Dennis Haysbert) agrees to preside over a case on a colonized planet that has never had any organized rule of law. On a world in which humans and aliens live side by side, he finds his first case is one of murder.

A desperate high school wrestling coach gives his team an untested performance-enhancing inhalant. Of course, the team suddenly starts winning…but their victory may be short-lived as the drug comes with killer side effects.

An employee of a computer company uncovers a plot by its CEO/founder to take control of the world's computer network by having computers communicate at a more sentient level and, if successful, set himself up for world domination

A woman who was abducted by aliens 17 years earlier tries to move past the mental scars, especially for the sake of her daughter, and finds love with a new teacher at her daughter's school. But she soon learns he is not the man he appears to be.

A rogue android who is part of the crew on Ganymede outpost threatens to destroy Earth's last hope of survival, claiming that human beings are no better than an infestation in the universe and not worthy of survival. And perhaps he is right…

A test to find the right soldier for a secret mission pushes the limits of each of the candidates. Placed in seemingly real and very dangerous situations, the candidates soon find the line between reality and simulation inexorably blurred.

Cliff Robertson stars as a radio station owner who builds a three-dimensional television receiver which accidentally intercepts a "galaxy being" whose strange form and deadly radiation triggers a tide of panic and violence!

In a terrifyingly timely story of genetic engineering and political power plays, Sidney Blackmer stars as a popular American President who puts into place a master plan to slowly and steadily destroy the United States. James Hong also stars.

In order to unifying the nations of Earth, a group of scientists sets out to secretly create the ultimate, global threat -- an all-powerful alien monster -- via human mutation! Robert Culp stars as the scientist chosen to undergo the transformation.

A meek, unassuming college professor (Donald Pleasence) invents a device capable of controlling the entire electro-magnetic spectrum and realizes the device has unleashed his subconscious thirst for revenge—with uncontrollable and deadly results!

Martin Landau stars as the time-traveler Andro who is desperately trying to stop the birth of a crazed 20th century inventor whose bacterium invention turns humans into hideous mutants. Shirley Knight co-stars in this classic, touching episode.

Both a cautionary tale and a tight courtroom drama, this haunting episode explores the fear and hostility that result when all privacy is eliminated...and all secrets are revealed! Jeff Corey, Peter Breck and Alan Baxter star.

In an isolated, snowbound outpost where a handful of people are on alert against enemy attack, a crazed Army major (Harry Guardino) is haunted by the ghost of a soldier he left to die. Sally Kellerman co-stars in one of her earliest TV appearances.

Two rock samples in Dr. Temple's (Barry Atwater) lab conceal protoplasmic alien invaders capable of controlling a human "corpus." Enter Paul Cameron (Robert Culp)...who can telepathically hear the "rocks" plotting their take-over of the world.

A six-man strike force is captured on the planet Ebon and brutally interrogated. And when they are suddenly allowed the "respect due a conquered enemy," the prisoners to conclude that there is a traitor among them...someone who must be killed!

Writer-producer Joseph Stefano creates both a macabre parable of the destructive potential of nuclear energy and a pulsating tale of terror featuring a superbly understated performance by Ed Asner. Scott Marlow and Michael Forrest also star.

In this highly charged, fascinating tale that explores the concept of alternate dimensions, a wealthy industrialist (Barry Jones) attempts to contact his dead son by funding a scientist's experiments in prying open the door to "the borderland."

They creep. They crawl. They kill. When the rulers of the planet Zanti are allowed to exile their criminals to our world, the screeching misfits will demonstrate to the military just what the word "invasion" really means. Bruce Dern stars.

Befuddled by the strange local custom of murder, two Martian administrators (Barry Morse and Carroll O'Connor) visit Earth to study one such crime and find themselves tempted to tamper with events in this whimsical tale from "The Outer Limits."

Film great Miriam Hopkins (1932's "Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde) returns to the screen to give a show-stopping performance as an overly ripe flapper who will stop at nothing to complete her long overdue wedding night scenario. John Hoyt also stars.

In one of the series' most unnerving episodes, Don Gordon portrays a secret government agent who infiltrates the ranks of the Invisibles -- a subversive, underground society of the nation's power brokers who are possessed by alien parasites.

Martin Landau and Sally Kellerman star as an inventor and his ambitious wife in a parable about aspiration's devolution into greed when a failed experiment leads to the interception of a powerful alien being from The Outer Limits.

When four brilliant young men born and raised in Spider County suddenly vanish and a fifth is accused of a murder he didn't commit, the boy receives a unique invitation from an alien being who is willing to take him to a home very, very far away.
